role.description:
**Quality/Risk Director Career Opportunity**

**Highly regarded and valued for your Quality/Risk Director expertise** 
Are you seeking a career that not only utilizes your skills but also aligns with your personal values, providing a profound sense of belonging and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in patients' lives? Look no further than Encompass Health, the nation's leader in in-patient rehabilitation care. As a Quality/Risk Director, you will oversee a hospital-wide quality management program, collaborating with various stakeholders to monitor and enhance the quality of patient care services. Join a team that values collaboration, support, and inclusivity, and embark on a rewarding career close to home and close to your heart, complete with access to cutting-edge equipment and technology and a comprehensive benefits package from day one.

**A Glimpse into Our World** 
At Encompass Health, you'll experience the difference the moment you become a part of our team. Being at Encompass Health means aligning with a rapidly growing national inpatient rehabilitation leader. We take pride in the growth opportunities we offer and how our team unites for the greater good of our patients. Our achievements include being named one of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and receiving the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® Award, among other accolades, which is nothing short of amazing.

**Starting Perks and Benefits** 
At Encompass Health, we are committed to creating a supportive, inclusive, and caring environment where you can thrive. From **day one,** you will have access to:

* Affordable medical, dental, and vision plans for both full-time and part-time employees and their families.
* Generous paid time off that accrues over time.
* Opportunities for tuition reimbursement and continuing education.
* Company-matching 401(k) and employee stock purchase plans.
* Flexible spending and health savings accounts.
* A vibrant community of individuals passionate about the work they do!

**Become the Quality/Risk Director you've always aspired to be**

* Ensure compliance with regulatory agencies, accrediting bodies, corporate and hospital policies, and procedures. Develop, implement, and maintain quality assessment and improvement programs.
* Assess compliance with federal, state, and industry regulatory and accreditation standards, facilitating processes to remediate and/or maintain compliance. Provide organizational education related to regulations and standards and coordinate local, state, federal, and accreditation surveys.
* Use a variety of applications (including, but not limited to, PatCom, UDS, ORYX, and Press Ganey) to identify improvement opportunities, generate reports, research issues, identify resources, and access external databases.
* Ensure the update and maintenance of hospital plans, including the Provision of Care/Scope of Services, Leadership, Information Management, Utilization Review, Infection Control, and Patient Safety plans. Oversee risk management activities, including completion of incident reports, notice of potential claims, corrective action planning, and incident reporting to the Corporate Risk Manager.
* Coordinate the review, development, and implementation of hospital policies.
* .Communicate and collaborate with other departments to coordinate care and promptly resolve patient concerns or complaints.
* Celebrate the accomplishments and successes of our dedicated employees along the way.

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor's degree in healthcare or a related field is preferred.
* License or Certification as required by state regulations.
* Experience in Quality and/or Risk Management, including primary responsibility for performance improvement activities, regulatory compliance, conflict resolution, leadership, and risk management activities.

We proudly set the standard in care by leading with empathy, doing what's right, focusing on the positive, and standing stronger together. Encompass Health is a trusted leader in post-acute care with over 150 nationwide locations and a team of 36,000 exceptional individuals and growing!

At Encompass Health, we celebrate and welcome diversity in our inclusive culture. role.title: Quality Control - Director of Quality
role.description:
Stanton is the leading designer and supplier of decorative high quality self-branded carpet, custom fabricated rugs and hard surfaces. Stanton sells its products across the mid to high end residential as well as decorative commercial marketplaces. Stanton is rated #1 Favorite Area Rug Manufacturer for Style, Quality & Service and Top 5 Favorite Carpet Manufacturer among our customers in Floor Focus magazine.
 
 
Stanton is seeking a strategic and technical Director of Quality Control for our Calhoun GA location. This leader will drive the strategic development of a global supplier management program, ensuring that every sourced product meets clearly defined performance criteria and customer expectations. Through thorough vetting and continuous performance monitoring, you will minimize risk and foster a culture of quality excellence. This role is pivotal in upholding Stanton’s commitment to excellence, ensuring our entire product portfolio delivers uncompromised quality, integrity, and performance from the source to the end customer.
 
 
**Responsibilities Include: (but not limited to):** 
Strategic Quality Systems & Standards
 

* Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive Quality Management System (QMS) to track, report, and resolve quality issues across all product lines (carpets, rugs, and hard surfaces).
* Oversee internal and external audits to ensure strict adherence to industry regulations, ISO 9001 standards, and accrediting agency requirements.
* Drive risk avoidance through rigorous and thorough vetting of product quality, performance, and adherence to industry and global standards.

Global Supplier Management & Partnering
 

* Establish and maintain strategic relationships with vendors and manufacturers; monitor supplier performance and evaluate auditing processes to ensure global supply chain adherence.
* Develop and maintain data-driven supplier scorecards to measure and improve quality performance.
* Lead the vetting process for global product suppliers to ensure clearly defined fitness-for-use criteria.

Technical Integrity & Continuous Improvement
 

* Direct testing procedures and routine inspections to assess raw materials and finished products, ensuring durability, aesthetic, and functional specifications are met.
* Lead root-cause analyses and develop Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) plans using Six Sigma or Lean methodologies to eliminate defects and improve efficiency.
* Analyze and report on quality metrics, trends, and performance to executive leadership and regulatory agencies as required.

Operational Oversight & Fiscal Responsibility
 

* Provide complete oversight and management of all downgraded inventory.
* Manage supplier chargebacks, ensuring financial accountability for quality failures.

Leadership & Organizational Culture
 

* Recruit, train, and manage Quality Control personnel, providing oversight of multiple QC inspectors daily.
* Conduct performance evaluations and foster a culture of quality, integrity, and performance excellence within the team.

**Qualifications Include:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Quality Management, or a related industrial/scientific field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* 8 to 10+ years of progressive, hands-on quality control/assurance management experience.
* Strong understanding of machine and hand-woven carpet manufacturing process.
* Strong understanding of all hard surface manufacturing.
* Working knowledge of installation procedures.
* Proven expertise in quality control methodologies such as Six Sigma or Lean.
* Deep knowledge of standards such as ISO 9001 and experience with quality management software.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of successful process improvement initiatives.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to train staff and liaise with external parties.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a strategic team.
* Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer; must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times to inspect product samples.

role.title: Director of Quality
role.description:
**SUMMARY:** The Quality Director is responsible for the overall quality of the products manufactured or sourced for our customers.

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:**

* Evaluates production operations from a strategic level to ensure products meet quality, integrity, functionality and other specifications and requirements.
* Ensures quality system processes, procedures and records are maintained and effectively implemented. Supports IATF16949 efforts, ensuring the timely follow-up on open issues related to the Quality System.

* Develops and communicates quality goals and performance metrics to achieve company objectives.
* Interacts directly and indirectly with customers to resolve complex issues.

* Collaborates with management and senior staff across departments to develop and maintain quality standards to address internal and external quality requirements.
* Facilitates and oversees the effective implementation of quality controls and risk assessments in new product introductions and change management using established methodologies.
* Oversees quality problem investigations and the implementation of corrective and/or preventative action when the product or process does not conform to stated requirements. Reviews the implementation of effective preventative action based upon the regular review of quality assurance data to reduce variation and waste and meet company goals and objectives. Ensures the timely disposition of non-conforming materials.
* Develops and maintains the warranty and product return process and ensures processes are in place to identify opportunities, create action plans, and to provide feedback for product and process improvements.
* Responsible for the ongoing management and development of assigned employees to produce a high performing quality organization. Determines staffing and skill requirements to meet organizational needs and implements plans to satisfy those requirements.
* Monitors the use and effectiveness of the Quality system process. Reviews metrics and results on a regular basis to identify trends and/or potential problem areas.
* Other duties as assigned.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Quality Systems: ISO 9001/IATF 16949, Internal Auditor, Customer Specific Requirements
* Documentation: Quality inspections, submission change forms, DMS, BOM/Routing, Quality Metrics
* APQP: PPAP, MSA, SPC
* Problem Solving: Corrective Action, Preventive Action, 8D, Root Cause Analysis
* Computer Skills: O365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams), Minitab, SAP (or other ERP system)
* Demonstrated leadership ability
* Ability to interact with all levels of customers

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* B.S. Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
* Minimum 10 years of Quality Engineering experience
* Minimum 5 years of management experience
* Industry experience with ISO9001 (IATF 16949 preferred), APQP, 8D and strong problem-solving skills

 

**Base Pay Range: $140k-$175k**

At Phillips and Temro Industries, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is listed above. Your base pay will depend on your skills, education, qualifications, experience, and location. The final salary offer will be based on these criteria and may differ based on the candidate's experience and qualifications and other job-related reasons. If you have any questions about the salary range, the compensation structure, or benefits offered feel free to reach out to HR@phillipsandtemro.com (mailto:HR@phillipsandtemro.com)

* Health insurance, dental, and vision (cost-share)
* HSA/FSA
* STD and LTD (company provided)
* Basic Life and AD&D (company provided)
* Voluntary Supplemental Life

* 401K plan with employer match
* Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
* Volunteer hours
* Annual bonus based on company performance
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Safety shoe and safety glasses reimbursement

role.title: SR. DIRECTOR, QUALITY ASSURANCE
role.description:
At El Pollo Loco, we are on a mission to be the nation’s leading fire-grilled chicken restaurant. When it comes to our people, we are all about growth. Whether that means specialized training, a clearly laid out career trajectory or collaborating cross-functionally, we are committed to the success of our people the same way we’ve been committed to the success of the El Pollo Loco brand for the last 50 years. In fact, we see you as our secret ingredient. While our chicken is fire, it’s our people who set us ablaze.
 
 
Our restaurants are only the tip of the flame! If you’re looking for an innovative, winning, and welcoming workplace, then a flamin’ good career in our Restaurant Support Center is right for you.
 
 
At our Support Center, we believe our best work is done Together, when departments collaborate and everyone is confident in contributing their ideas. This is why we are in the office 3 days per week.
 
 
Let’s Get Loco!
 
 
What’s in it for you!
 
 

* STRONG office culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® and driven by our core values: Simple. Together. Relentless. Ownership. Nimble. Growth
* Career growth opportunities
* Competitive pay and bonus potential
* Be an Owner: Equity Compensation
* Medical + Dental + Vision Insurance + HSA Savings Account
* 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match and immediate vesting
* Paid Vacation + Sick Pay + 12 Paid Holidays
* Employee Assistance Program
* Free El Pollo Loco food + restaurant discounts
* PerkSpot discounts program

**POSITION PURPOSE:** 
The Senior Director, Quality Assurance owns El Pollo Loco's enterprise quality assurance function end to end, consolidating vendor-level quality assurance and regulatory food safety compliance into a single point of accountability. This role is responsible for the integrity of the supply chain's quality systems — from supplier and co-manufacturer qualification through regulatory compliance across federal, state, and local agencies — and serves as the primary quality and food safety resource to the franchise system.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
Vendor & Supplier Quality Assurance
 

* Directs vendor and supplier quality assurance programs across El Pollo Loco's poultry portfolio, including fresh leg quarters (“Saddles”) and value-added further-processed chicken items, ensuring specification integrity, ingredient consistency, and product quality at every stage of the supply chain.
* Leads vendor qualification, audit, scorecarding, and corrective-action programs; partners with Procurement and Distribution to resolve quality holds, non-conformances, and supplier performance issues.
* Owns quality specifications for co-manufactured and further-processed chicken products, working directly with processors to validate manufacturing controls, shelf-life, and food safety design prior to system-wide rollout.
* Evaluates and approves new vendors, ingredients, and product formulations, ensuring alignment with brand quality standards and regulatory requirements.

Regulatory & Food Safety Compliance
 

* Serves as the company's senior point of accountability for food safety regulatory compliance, including FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP, GFSI, and state and local health department requirements across all operating jurisdictions.
* Builds and maintains direct working relationships with state and federal regulatory agencies; leads the company's response to regulatory inquiries, inspections, and enforcement actions.
* Owns crisis management, product withdrawal, and recall protocols (including activation of the Level 3 Withdrawal Process), partnering with executive leadership and legal counsel as needed.
* Directs internal and third-party food safety audit programs spanning restaurants, distribution centers, and manufacturing partners.

Team Leadership & Franchise Support
 

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing QA organization spanning both vendor quality and regulatory food safety disciplines; sets performance expectations, coaching plans, and succession pipelines for direct reports.
* Serves as a critical QA partner to the franchise system, delivering training, technical guidance, and responsive support to franchisees on quality and food safety matters.
* Represents Quality Assurance in cross-functional and executive leadership forums, translating vendor and regulatory risk into clear, actionable guidance for Operations and senior leadership.
* Other duties as assigned by the SVP, Supply Chain & Quality Assurance.

QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:
 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required.
 
 
**Education/Work Experience:** 
BA/BS in Food Science, Food Microbiology, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred. Minimum 12+ years of progressive quality assurance and food safety experience, with substantial, direct experience in poultry and value-added/further-processed chicken products required. Demonstrated background working directly with state and federal regulatory agencies (FDA, USDA, state health departments) on compliance, inspections, or enforcement matters required. Prior experience directly managing and developing a quality assurance team required.
 
 
**License/Certifications:** 
Valid driver's license required. HACCP certification required; PCQI (Preventive Controls Qualified Individual) preferred.
 
 
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** 

* Proven track record building, managing, and developing high-performing quality assurance teams, with strong people-leadership, coaching, and succession-planning skills.
* Deep working knowledge of value-added and further-processed chicken manufacturing, including co-manufacturer oversight, specification management, and shelf-life validation.
* Established credibility with state and federal regulatory agencies; skilled at navigating inspections, audits, and enforcement proceedings with composure and precision.
* Demonstrated ability to support and train franchisees on quality and food safety standards, balancing brand protection with practical, field-level guidance.
* Confidence in execution of strategic initiatives; decisive and able to make fact-based decisions under pressure.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset and skills; meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to effectively communicate with internal and external business partners, including vendors, regulators, and franchisees.
* Ability to prioritize and plan competing, time-sensitive work assignments under frequent, tight deadlines.
* Ability to read, write, and interpret complex regulatory reports, contracts, and correspondence.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment on matters of significant risk and consequence to the company.
* Ability to work weekends and extended work schedules as needed.
* Willing and able to travel locally within Southern California and to out-of-state vendor, distribution, and restaurant locations, as needed, by car or airplane.

Our Company
 
 
In 1980 the first American El Pollo Loco opened on Alvarado Street in Los Angeles, quickly becoming a destination for the best citrus-marinated, fire-grilled pollo in town. Over the past four decades, El Pollo Loco has grown into more than 500 restaurants across 9 states, becoming an L.A. mainstay and cultural benchmark along the way. Today, we continue to work just as hard to always provide our customers with Quality Chicken. Fast. Easy. Affordable.
 
 
PAY DISCLAIMER – CA ONLY
 
The pay range identified is the hourly or salary rate El Pollo Loco expects to pay for the posted position. This range does not include any benefits or bonus opportunities that might be available for the position based on position and eligibility criteria. At El Pollo Loco, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range. Individual pay decisions will vary based on a variety of factors including years of experience, industry experience, education, geography, etc.

role.description:
**Quality Director**
--------------------

Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control

Reports To: Executive Leadership

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: INOX SOLAR Manufacturing Facility

**Job** **Summary**
-------------------

The Director of Quality is responsible for leading and overseeing all quality assurance and quality control activities at INOX SOLAR USA. This position ensures that solar modules, manufacturing processes, raw materials, and finished products meet established quality standards, customer requirements, applicable regulatory requirements, and company specifications.

The Quality Director develops and implements quality management systems, drives continuous improvement initiatives, leads quality investigations, and partners with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to reduce defects, improve product reliability, and maintain consistent manufacturing performance.

**Essential** **Duties** **and** **Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------------------

### **1.** **Quality** **Leadership** **and** **Strategy**

* Develop and implement the company's overall quality strategy, objectives, policies, and procedures.
* Establish quality performance metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and departmental goals.
* Lead the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, including inspectors, technicians, engineers, and supervisors.
* Establish accountability for quality performance across all manufacturing departments.
* Provide regular quality performance reports, trend analyses, and improvement recommendations to executive leadership.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

### **2.** **Quality** **Management** **Systems** **and** **Compliance**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS).
* Ensure compliance with applicable ISO standards, customer specifications, industry requirements, and internal quality procedures.
* Maintain controlled quality documentation, inspection records, work instructions, and standard operating procedures.
* Lead internal audits, support external audits, and coordinate corrective actions resulting from audit findings.
* Maintain appropriate records to support product traceability, quality investigations, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate quality certification activities and customer or third-party audits as applicable.

### **3.** **Solar** **Module** **Manufacturing** **Quality**

* Oversee quality throughout the solar module manufacturing process, from incoming materials to final product release.
* Establish and maintain inspection standards for incoming materials, in-process production, and finished solar modules.
* Monitor manufacturing quality at critical production stages, including cell handling, stringing, layup, lamination, framing, junction box installation, EL testing, final inspection, and packaging.
* Ensure effective implementation of electroluminescence (EL) testing, visual inspections, electrical performance testing, and other required quality verification activities.
* Investigate manufacturing defects, process deviations, nonconforming products, and recurring quality issues.
* Work with Production and Engineering to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Establish procedures for product identification, traceability, nonconforming material control, and final product release.

### **4.** **Quality** **Control** **and** **Performance** **Improvement**

* Establish and monitor quality KPIs, including defect rates, first-pass yield, scrap rates, rework, customer complaints, and corrective action closure.
* Analyze quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead root cause analysis using appropriate methodologies, such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagrams, and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
* Implement corrective and preventive action processes to prevent recurrence of quality issues.
* Partner with Production and Engineering to improve process capability, reduce variation, and minimize manufacturing losses.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

### **5.** **Supplier** **and** **Incoming** **Quality** **Management**

* Establish supplier quality standards and incoming material inspection requirements.
* Collaborate with Purchasing, Supply Chain, and Engineering to evaluate supplier quality performance.
* Lead supplier corrective action requests and investigations involving defective or nonconforming materials.
* Monitor supplier quality trends and recommend supplier improvement plans when necessary.
* Support supplier audits, qualification activities, and ongoing supplier performance reviews.

### **6.** **Customer** **Quality** **and** **Product** **Reliability**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for significant customer quality concerns and escalations.
* Oversee investigations into customer complaints, product defects, and warranty-related quality issues.
* Coordinate corrective action responses and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.
* Prepare quality reports and technical documentation for customers and executive leadership.
* Collaborate with relevant departments to identify opportunities to improve product reliability and customer satisfaction.
* Support product testing, validation, and quality requirements associated with new products and manufacturing process changes.

### **7.** **Leadership** **and** **Team** **Development**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and evaluate Quality Department employees.
* Establish clear departmental responsibilities, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Provide training on quality standards, inspection procedures, documentation, and problem-solving methods.
* Ensure adequate staffing, equipment, and resources to support production quality requirements.
* Collaborate with department leaders to address quality issues and strengthen cross-functional communication.
* Encourage employees to identify quality risks and take appropriate action to prevent defects.

### **8.** **Risk** **Management** **and** **Continuous** **Improvement**

* Identify and evaluate risks that could affect product quality, reliability, safety, or customer satisfaction.
* Implement preventive controls to reduce the likelihood of manufacturing defects and product failures.
* Review quality risks associated with new equipment, process changes, materials, and product designs.
* Support change management processes to ensure changes are properly reviewed, validated, documented, and approved.
* Monitor emerging quality concerns and recommend appropriate preventive measures.
* Ensure lessons learned from quality incidents are incorporated into manufacturing procedures and employee training.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field required.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or Business Administration preferred.

### **Experience**

* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality control, or manufacturing quality management.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing quality teams or departments.
* Experience in solar module manufacturing, photovoltaic production, electronics manufacturing, or a related manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and maintaining quality management systems.
* Experience leading internal and external audits, root cause investigations, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing customer quality concerns, supplier quality issues, and manufacturing process improvements.

### **Technical** **Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and ISO 9001 requirements.
* Familiarity with applicable photovoltaic module standards, such as IEC 61215 and IEC 61730, as relevant to the company's products and markets.
* Knowledge of manufacturing inspection methods, product testing, defect analysis, and quality documentation.
* Experience with root cause analysis, CAPA, FMEA, statistical process control (SPC), and other quality improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and quality reporting or manufacturing data systems.
* Ability to analyze complex quality data and translate findings into actionable improvement plans.

**Core** **Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strategic leadership and decision-making
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail and commitment to product quality
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Effective communication and presentation skills
* Employee development and team management
* Risk assessment and corrective action management
* Continuous improvement and process optimization
* Customer focus and accountability

**Performance** **Measures** **(KPIs)**
---------------------------------------

The Director of Quality will be evaluated based on performance against established departmental and company goals, including:

* First-pass yield and overall production yield
* Manufacturing defect and nonconformance rates
* Scrap and rework reduction
* Customer complaints and warranty-related quality trends
* Corrective and preventive action closure rates
* Supplier defect rates and supplier corrective action performance
* Internal and external audit results
* Quality documentation accuracy and compliance
* Employee training completion and team performance
* Progress toward continuous improvement and product reliability goals

**Working** **Conditions**
--------------------------

* Work is performed in both an office and manufacturing environment.
* Regular presence on the production floor is required to monitor quality performance and support investigations.
* Must be able to work collaboratively with production personnel, engineers, technicians, suppliers, customers, and executive leadership.
* May require occasional extended hours or schedule flexibility to address significant quality issues, production concerns, audits, or customer escalations.
* Must comply with applicable company safety policies and manufacturing facility requirements.

**Equal** **Employment** **Opportunity**
----------------------------------------

INOX SOLAR is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

role.description:
**Salary: $93,000 - $98,000 per year**

Catholic Charities of Baltimore is seeking a Director of Data and Quality to lead the systems, standards, and insights that drive safe, equitable, effective, and accountable service delivery across the Division. Integrating quality assurance, performance, data governance, client experience, professional practice, and risk, the Director turns information into action, aligns stakeholders around shared priorities, and advances sustainable improvement. This position is expected to work in close partnership with the Director of Performance Management, supporting agency-wide performance initiatives and ensuring divisional practices align with organizational standards and priorities. Through strategic influence and disciplined oversight, the Director strengthens outcomes, accountability, and mission impact.

**The work schedule is Monday to Friday 8 AM - 4 PM or 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM.**

**JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Quality Assurance, Performance & Data Governance**

* Provides strategic oversight of divisional quality assurance, performance management, data governance, and continuous improvement, establishing standards and accountability that align services with organizational priorities and promote equitable, trauma-informed, outcomes-driven practice.
* Leads divisional performance management reviews in alignment with agency-wide performance standards and in coordination with the Director of Performance Management; establishes and monitors measurable goals and key performance indicators, evaluates results, assigns follow-up actions, and works with divisional leadership to ensure accountability for timely, sustained improvement.
* Partners closely with the agency's Director of Performance Management to advance agency-wide standards for data integrity, performance accountability, client outcomes, and continuous quality improvement.
* Serves as the Division's primary liaison for agency-wide performance initiatives and is responsible for responding to requests, facilitating reviews of program operations, data collection practices, and client service processes, and ensuring that identified improvements are implemented in a timely and effective manner.
* Directs data governance, quality controls, workflows, and documentation standards to ensure information is accurate, timely, compliant, audit-ready, and consistently usable for decision-making and reporting across programs.
* Analyzes program, client, and operational data to identify trends, risks, strengths, and performance gaps; translates findings into recommendations and actions that improve outcomes, service effectiveness, and resource decisions.
* Partners with divisional leaders to design, implement, monitor, and evaluate quality-improvement initiatives; establishes corrective actions and verifies that changes are completed, sustained, and achieve intended results.
* Partners with divisional leaders and Development to define, monitor, validate, and report measurable program and grant outcomes that demonstrate effectiveness, meet funder requirements, and inform future strategy.
* Serves as the Division’s technical systems administrator for ServicePoint and HMIS platforms, accountable for system configuration, permissions, licensing, integrations, vendor coordination, troubleshooting, data transfers, compliant use, and data continuity; serves as functional lead for EHR and other systems, supporting training, workflows, adoption, and data quality.
* Directs the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, user guidance, and recurring agency, program, and grant reports, ensuring staff and stakeholders receive clear requirements and accurate, actionable information.

**Strategic Partnership & Client Experience**

* Serves on the Community Services Leadership Team, providing quality, performance, data, risk, and client-experience expertise that informs divisional strategy, resource priorities, operational decisions, and executive accountability.
* Partners with program leaders to assess operations and system effectiveness, identify gaps, risks, and emerging needs, and ensure agreed improvements are implemented, monitored, and sustained.
* Leads change management for new standards, systems, and practices by engaging stakeholders, communicating expectations, addressing barriers, clarifying accountability, and monitoring adoption and effectiveness.
* Oversees client satisfaction measurement and integrates client feedback with performance data to establish priorities, shape training and practice improvements, and strengthen the client experience.
* Establishes and monitors trauma-informed, ethical, equitable, and consistent professional practice standards for staff serving complex and high-risk populations, addressing gaps through guidance, training, and corrective action.
* Researches and evaluates evidence-informed practices and process improvements; develops training, resources, and tools that support implementation, strengthen program effectiveness, and promote consistent outcome measurement.

**Compliance & Emergency Preparedness**

* Directs divisional risk management, ensuring potential and actual risks and incidents are promptly identified, documented, investigated, mitigated, escalated, and reported in accordance with agency standards and applicable requirements.
* Coordinates incident investigations and root cause analyses with relevant agency departments; establishes corrective actions, assigns accountability, and verifies timely completion and effectiveness to reduce recurrence and organizational exposure.
* Monitors compliance with regulations, agency policies, professional standards, and ethical requirements; escalates significant concerns, directs remediation, and verifies that corrective measures address identified deficiencies.
* Oversees divisional emergency preparedness, maintaining current protocols and ensuring staff receive the training, guidance, and practice needed for safe, consistent, and effective response.
* Prepares and validates timely risk and compliance reports; communicates trends, root causes, corrective actions, and outcomes to support informed leadership decisions and proactive risk reduction.
* Represents the Division on agency Compliance and Emergency Preparedness Committees, communicates divisional risks and obligations, and ensures assigned follow-up actions are completed.
* Performs other duties as assigned in support of divisional and organizational priorities.

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in human services, business administration, public administration, healthcare administration, quality management, data analytics, or a related field.
* Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in human services, quality assurance, performance management, program operations, business administration, or a related field, including three (3) years leading cross-functional initiatives, influencing organizational practices, using data to guide decisions, and driving accountability and improvement.
* An equivalent combination of relevant education and progressively responsible experience may be considered if it demonstrates the knowledge, leadership capability, and technical competencies required for the position.
* Demonstrated experience managing program data, developing dashboards and performance measures, analyzing trends, producing decision-ready reports, facilitating performance reviews, and leading quality-improvement initiatives with measurable outcomes.
* Experience administering client-service, case-management, or electronic record systems, including configuration, access and permissions, licensing, integrations, vendor coordination, troubleshooting, data transfers, business continuity, staff training, workflow support, user adoption, and data-quality monitoring.
* Extensive knowledge of nonprofit best practices, program evaluation methods, processes, regulations, and procedures.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & ABILITIES:**

* Exercises advanced critical thinking and judgment to resolve operational and risk challenges and advance divisional priorities.
* Applies strong data literacy to define measures, assess quality, interpret trends and causes, and communicate actionable recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Communicates complex information clearly and persuasively, translating it into actionable guidance and stakeholder alignment.
* Builds high-trust relationships that strengthen collaboration, accountability, and service excellence while demonstrating discretion, professionalism, confidentiality, and integrity.
* Leads with strategic planning and discipline, prioritizing competing demands while ensuring accurate, efficient, and consistent execution.
* Demonstrates integrity, accountability, ethical judgment, conflict-management skill, and autonomy in advancing divisional goals.
* Requires proficiency in using computer systems and software to perform job function, including but not limited to, basic Windows PC, web browsing (i.e., Chrome, Internet Explorer, etc.), database management systems, and Microsoft Outlook. Knowledge of other Microsoft Office applications, such as Word, Excel PowerPoint, Teams, and OneDrive is

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Hybrid work options are available, contingent upon business needs and performance expectations in alignment with the Agency’s policy.
* Remaining in a stationary position, which may involve standing or sitting for extended periods, as required to complete tasks or duties associated with the role
* Moving about to accomplish tasks or transitioning between different work sites, which may involve walking, standing, or traveling to various locations as required by the role.
* Engaging in communication with others to exchange information, which may involve speaking, listening, writing, or using electronic communication methods to ensure clear and effective understanding. This includes both verbal and non-verbal interactions with colleagues, clients, or external parties.
* Repetitive motions involving the wrists, hands, and/or fingers, including tasks such as typing, data entry, or handling small objects. These repetitive activities may occur throughout the workday and require attention to ergonomics to ensure comfort and minimize strain.
* Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and completeness of assigned work to ensure it meets quality standards and adheres to established guidelines.
* Hearing and vision abilities, with or without correction, sufficient to drive safely and effectively observe and communicate with others.

We offer a wide range of benefits to meet the ever-changing needs of our employees including but not limited to:

* Health/Dental/Vision
* Vacation/sick/holiday pay
* 403(b) Retirement Plan with a discretionary employer contribution
* Tuition Advancement
* Paid Parental Leave

role.title: Director, Quality Assurance - Engine Component Repair Services
role.description:
Chromalloy is a global engineering & solutions company. We are a leading provider of aftermarket parts, repairs, and solutions that safely & reliably extend the life of aircraft engines and gas turbines. We develop, manufacture and repair critical turbine components for a range of engine platforms. Our solutions support the engines running the aerospace, energy and defense industries around the world.
 
**Video:** What We Do
 
Why work at Chromalloy?
 
Chromalloy employees are proud, passionate problem-solvers who strive to live our values every day. A career with Chromalloy is an opportunity to learn from top industry experts, work with important technologies, and unlock a passion for innovation. Join our team of experts, innovators and problem-solvers delivering world-class solutions for our customers. As a global company, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees feel represented, heard, and able to bring their best selves to work every day. Be part of something bigger with Chromalloy!
 
Our Total Rewards Program is designed to support you today and in the future.
 

* Comprehensive and flexible benefit options starting on day one, including medical, dental, vision, EAP, wellness incentives, and 401(k) with employer matching.
* Development & progression opportunities for every employee – regular performance conversations, training and development curriculum, and engineering fellowship programs.
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and parental leave—all eligible on your first day of employment!
* Competitive pay, including eligibility for quarterly and annual bonuses, depending on role and site.

Eligibility for individual benefit plans may vary based on employment status.
 
 
Job Summary
 
We're looking for a Director, Quality Assurance - Engine Component Repair Services (ECRS) to provide strategic and day-to-day quality leadership across Chromalloy’s ECRS repair locations. This highly visible role leads site Quality Managers and drives consistent quality strategy, regulatory compliance, product integrity, customer performance, and continuous improvement across the segment.
 
 
The successful candidate will partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Commercial, and corporate Quality leaders to reduce risk, strengthen operating discipline, and support safe, compliant business growth. This leader will translate strategy into action, develop strong teams, and communicate effectively from the shop floor to the executive level.
 
 
Work That Matters
 
At Chromalloy, your work directly supports aviation safety and reliability. Our teams repair and manufacture critical aerospace components used across the global aviation industry. As a people leader, you’ll help ensure our repair locations deliver compliant, reliable products and services that keep aircraft flying safely around the world.
 
 
**Location:** United States, based at a Chromalloy site
 
**Travel:** Regular domestic and international travel to ECRS repair locations, customers, and regulatory activities
 
 
What You’ll Be Doing
 

* Own and deploy the ECRS segment quality strategy, priorities, operating rhythm, and improvement roadmap across repair locations.
* Lead, coach, and hold accountable site Quality Managers while strengthening succession, capability, and organizational depth.
* Serve as the senior Quality partner to segment leadership and communicate performance, risks, resource needs, and recovery plans to executive leaders.
* Ensure compliance with FAA Part 145 and applicable FAA, EASA, CAAC, UK CAA, certification, customer, and internal requirements.
* Drive audit readiness, corrective action, effectiveness reviews, and prevention of repeat findings across the segment.
* Use quality metrics and risk signals to improve performance, reduce quality escapes, and strengthen product and customer outcomes.
* Lead responses to significant customer concerns, product escapes, investigations, containment, risk evaluation, and recovery plans.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve first-pass yield, process capability, documentation discipline, and defect prevention without compromising compliance.
* Drive consistent quality governance, data standards, management reviews, and electronic quality management workflows across ECRS locations.
* Build trusted relationships with customers, regulators, and certification bodies through clear communication and disciplined follow-through.

What We’re Looking For
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Aerospace, Manufacturing, Quality, Business, or a related technical discipline.
* At least 12 years of progressive aerospace quality, maintenance/repair/overhaul, repair-station, manufacturing, engineering, or operational leadership experience.
* At least 7 years of people-leadership experience, including leadership of site Quality Managers or a comparable multi-site quality organization.
* Demonstrated experience with FAA Part 145 repair-station operations and applicable aviation regulatory requirements.
* Proven success leading quality performance, regulatory compliance, customer recovery, audits, investigations, and corrective-action programs across multiple facilities.
* Strong executive communication, judgment under pressure, and willingness to escalate or stop work when compliance, airworthiness, or product integrity may be at risk.

Nice to Have
 

* Master’s degree.
* ASQ quality certification, Lead Auditor certification, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
* FAA Repairman Certificate experience or prior accountable quality leadership within a repair station.
* Experience leading international aerospace repair locations and working directly with aviation authorities and major aerospace customers.
* Experience deploying an enterprise electronic quality management system, including ComplianceQuest or a comparable platform.

Leadership Expectations and Values
 

* Model the Way – Leads with integrity and accountability, holding themselves to the same standards expected of others and consistently following through on commitments.
* Inspire a Shared Vision – Connects team efforts to a clear, meaningful purpose while balancing strategic priorities with disciplined day-to-day execution.
* Challenge the Process – Brings curiosity and a drive for continuous improvement, questioning assumptions and championing innovation even in complex environments.
* Enable Others to Act – Builds strong, inclusive partnerships that share ownership, develop others, and value diverse perspectives.
* Encourage the Heart – Recognizes contributions genuinely and celebrates shared values to build a culture of appreciation, respect, and accountability.

This position may require work hours outside of the regularly scheduled hours to meet operational needs. This may include work during evenings, weekends, and/or holidays. Additional work hours are assigned based on business requirements. Non-exempt employees will be paid overtime in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
 
The salary range for this position reflects a broad spectrum of experience levels. Individual compensation within the range is determined by multiple factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, job related skills, internal equity, and market conditions. We evaluate each candidate individually to ensure fair and competitive pay decisions.
 
Due to government regulation only US persons (U.S. citizen, U.S. naturalized citizen, U.S. permanent resident, holder of U.S. approved political asylee or refugee status) may be considered for this role.
 
Chromalloy participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.
 
Any offer of employment will also be conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen in accordance with company policy and applicable federal and state regulations.
 
Chromalloy is an equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled.
 
In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please contact: https://www.chromalloy.com/contact-us/

role.title: VP, Manufacturing - Fresh Bakery
role.description:
**Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.**

**Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.**

**Why Campbell’s…**

* Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
* Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
* Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
* If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
* Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
* Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

**Job Description**

The Vice President, Manufacturing – Fresh Bakery provides strategic and operational leadership for Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing network, including bakery operations in Bloomfield, Connecticut; Downers Grove, Illinois; Lakeland, Florida; and Denver, Pennsylvania. This leader establishes the manufacturing strategy, operating priorities, performance expectations, and transformation agenda for the network, ensuring consistent execution across safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, productivity, and people.

Leading through the Plant Managers, the VP creates alignment across sites while maintaining clear site-level accountability for day-to-day operations and results. The role builds manufacturing capability and organizational talent across the network, identifies and addresses systemic performance opportunities, and drives continuous improvement and transformation to strengthen the long-term competitiveness of the Fresh Bakery business.

This leader partners across Supply Chain and the broader organization to align manufacturing strategy, capabilities, capacity, capital priorities, and resources with business needs. The incumbent must be an enterprise-minded business partner who creates direction, enables effective decisions, builds talent and culture, drives disciplined execution, and owns results across the network.

**Essential Job Duties**

**Manufacturing Strategy & Network Leadership:** Define and lead the multi-year manufacturing strategy for the Fresh Bakery network. Translate business and Supply Chain priorities into clear site objectives, integrated roadmaps, operating plans, and performance expectations. Maintain clarity between network-level strategic direction and Plant Manager ownership of daily site operations.

**Safety, Quality & Operating Integrity:** Set expectations and governance for employee safety, food safety, product quality, environmental responsibility, and regulatory compliance across all bakery sites. Ensure effective management systems, standards, controls, and escalation routines are in place, while holding Plant Managers accountable for site execution and results.

**Network Performance Management & Accountability:** Establish the operating cadence and performance-management system for safety, quality, service, cost, labor, yield, waste, reliability, customer service, and employee engagement. Review performance across sites, identify systemic gaps and best practices, define corrective actions, and ensure clear ownership and follow-through.

**Manufacturing Transformation & Operational Excellence:** Lead the transformation agenda for Fresh Bakery manufacturing, creating consistent operating systems, standards, and management routines across the network. Build a culture of continuous improvement and zero loss, and use Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance, equipment reliability, and problem-solving disciplines to deliver sustainable improvements.

**Cost, Productivity & Business Performance:** Deliver network productivity, cost, waste, and efficiency commitments through disciplined planning and execution. Connect operational performance to financial outcomes, evaluate trade-offs, and mobilize cross-site resources to address significant performance gaps or opportunities.

**Capacity, Capability & Capital Strategy:** Shape network capacity, capability, technology, and capital priorities based on demand, growth, service, risk, and long-term business needs. Sponsor major capital and capability initiatives, ensure disciplined prioritization and governance, and partner with Engineering and other functions to achieve intended business outcomes.

**Talent, Leadership & Culture%:** Build a strong and diverse manufacturing leadership pipeline across the Fresh Bakery network. Coach and develop Plant Managers and senior site leaders; strengthen succession, bench strength, workforce planning, engagement, and retention; and create a high-performing culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional & Enterprise Partnership:** Partner with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Research & Development, Commercial, Finance, People & Culture, and other stakeholders to align priorities, solve network constraints, support innovation and commercialization, manage risk, and deliver enterprise outcomes. Serve as the senior manufacturing voice for the Fresh Bakery business.

· Fresh Bakery manufacturing experience strongly preferred

· 15+ years of progressive manufacturing/operations experience

· Significant people leadership experience, including leadership of senior operational leaders

· Multi-site leadership experience, likely something I'd make required or strongly preferred

**Preferred Experienc** e

· Multi-site manufacturing leadership experience, including leadership through Plant Managers or comparable senior site leaders.

· Experience in food manufacturing or consumer packaged goods (CPG) within a complex, high-volume manufacturing network.

· Demonstrated experience leading large-scale manufacturing transformation and operational excellence, with a track record of driving sustainable improvements in safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, and productivity.

· Experience applying Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), reliability, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies at scale.

role.title: General Manager - Automotive Manufacturing
role.description:
"An Equal Opportunity Employer” It is the policy of North American Stamping Group to provide employment, training, promotion, and other conditions of Employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age or status as a qualified individual with a disability or other status protected by law.
 
 
GENERAL SUMMARY
 
Plans, advises, consults, leads, and coordinates manufacturing, manufacturing support, and administration and organizational development activities for one or multiple facilities through Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Purchasing, Quality, Tooling, and Production Control to ensure efficient production of parts with the best material usage, quality levels, and service that exceed the customer’s expectations. Responsible for ensuring all key measures are met from plant and business operations. Leads and promotes matters related to safety, health, environmental, labor control, equipment, material, processes, and customer relations.
 
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
 
A. Serve as management consultant to assigned locations ensuring the management of the company aligns with North American Stamping Group, LLC standard operating procedures and provide subject matter expertise and assistance to increase operating and management efficiency.
 
B. Lead, plan, and manage all manufacturing activities and related functions at assigned locations including production, engineering, maintenance, purchasing, quality, tooling, and production control to ensure safety and quality and to meet and exceed customer and company requirements.
 
1. Lead manufacturing supervision in utilizing Total Quality Production System (TQPS) techniques to standardize processes/methods and to identify manufacturing problems and raw materials/components supply, and eliminate waste.
 
2. Ensure that feasibility studies are carried out correctly for the products to be manufactured at the facility, compatible with the footprint, investment, and quality capabilities planned.
 
3. Develop and monitor Lean activities and a manufacturing continuous improvement system.
 
4. Review launch products and engineering changes implementation and provide direction for successful launch.
 
5. Plan and organize layouts for line changes due to volume changes or manpower reductions.
 
6. Maintain contact with interdepartmental managers to provide feedback when dealing with process or material changes.
 
7. Hold daily staff meetings to communicate daily objectives and discuss successes, failures, and countermeasure activity.
 
8. Ensure NASG philosophies, systems, and processes are being followed at all times.
 
9. Maintain Master Capacity Plan for the facility for accurate budget and capital needs.
 
C. Lead and direct both strategic planning and tactical execution of manufacturing, manufacturing support, and administration functions.
 
D. Understand and execute all plant policies and procedures.
 
1. Structure and implement plant policies and procedures to ensure safe and efficient operation of the company and its associates.
 
2. Ensure alignment of plant policies and procedures, including associate handbook, with corporate policies and procedures.
 
3. Manage plant practices and procedures in compliance with company and industry standards (e.g., IATF16949 and ISO14001).
 
E. Lead development and management of annual plan, budget, key measures, operating efficiency, and cost control.
 
1. Develop annual plan and budget for plant aligned with corporate goals as the foundation to keep the plant moving in a safe, quality conscious, and efficient upward trend.
 
2. Review quotations of new products to ensure compliance with the manufacturing footprint and investment/manpower plans.
 
3. Administer annual plan that incorporates safety, quality, productivity, cost reduction, and associate morale.
 
4. Mutually establish goals and objectives with VP, Manufacturing quarterly.
 
5. Ensure plant goals are met and kept on track.
 
6. Develop, plan, and maintain the budget for plant including making adjustments to achieve targets. Maintain direct and indirect labor budgets while meeting quality and order fill requirements.
 
7. Review and track posted daily, weekly, and monthly goals (including Key Measure targets and results), spot potential problems, and lead in formulating and implementing short-term and long-term countermeasures and solutions.
 
8. Review and plan headcount weekly for labor cost control and operating equipment efficiency (OEE).
 
9. Support and resolve accounts receivable issues with the finance team to ensure timely collection.
 
10. Oversee the monthly reporting documents that are finalized for the plant, ensuring accuracy and completion. Report out monthly reports with targets. Conduct Monthly Management Review meetings.
 
11. Lead management discussions and planning sessions to help formulate cost reduction, waste reduction, product improvement, and problem solving activities, and present operational performance daily/weekly.
 
F. Act as key contact for customers and local industry groups.
 
1. Conduct plant tours and host customer meetings as required.
 
2. Ensure all parts are made to customer requirements in accordance with company policy.
 
3. Support activities to develop and improve customer relations and obtain future business opportunities.
 
4. Develop relationships with local industry groups including those related to manufacturing, automotive, human resources, education and training, legal services, and financial.
 
G. Manage and direct staff in assigned Manufacturing group with a focus on equipment, processes, human resource allocation, cost management, setting priorities, removing roadblocks, and leading through problem identification and resolution, and implementation of short- and long-term corrective actions to manufacturing problems.
 
1. Assign production and engineering staff to support all assigned projects on time and budget with accepted quality.
 
2. Lead staff in activities to meet and improve standard costs of operation both in material and output; minimize downtime; maintain good 5S at all times; reduce cost of quality internal/external failure and PPM; optimize material utilization; optimize raw material, WIP, and finished goods inventory; improve material specifications; and maintain preventative maintenance program.
 
3. Develop and maintain positive associate relations centered on mutual trust, dignity, respect, fairness, consistency, two-way communication, teamwork, and harmony.
 
4. Provide direction and motivation to associates emphasizing quality, efficiency, productivity, cost reduction, safety and health, and morale.
 
5. Ensure further development of associates through performance evaluation, development of training plans, feedback, coaching, and cascade training. Update associate training matrix and schedule any needed training.
 
6. Conduct monthly meetings with associates to communicate state of business.
 
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS
 
 
**Education:** 

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, or related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Auditor training through ISO 14001/IATF16949 preferred.

**Experience:** 

* At least 10 years of functional leadership experience as a manager in a manufacturing environment, preferably automotive stamping.
* Minimum of 12 years of relevant work experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in automotive stamping, welding, and/or related components (e.g., seating, emissions, ride control, NVH, tooling, and other miscellaneous components).

**Personal/Technical Skills:** 

* General understanding and working knowledge of manufacturing, assembly, and welding equipment and tooling including design, automation, robotics, or manufacturing processes (and all secondary related processes) relating to automotive stamping.
* Working knowledge of tool, gauges and equipment design, automation, robotics, and/or manufacturing processes.
* Practical experience and working knowledge of Basic Equipment Care (BEC) and Preventive Maintenance Optimization (PMO) systems for machinery, tooling, and gauges.
* Practical experience applying Lean principles in an automotive environment.
* General understanding and practical work experience with automotive quality systems and processes.
* Working knowledge of material types specifications and characteristics used in automotive stampings.
* Practical experience applying Total Quality Production System (TQPS) principles in an automotive environment.
* Thorough understanding of company product, trade terminology, quality management and control systems and techniques, manufacturing processes including material controls, work flow, scheduling, kanban, and equipment and machine operation.
* Versed in statistical data entry and utilization of trend analysis.
* Ability to implement plans to control and maintain safety, quality, 5S, cost, and efficiency for assigned areas.
* Strong organization, time management, and planning skills and ability to manage multiple tasks with tight deadlines.
* Ability to teach managers, group leaders, team leaders, and associates in basic fundamental skills and facilitate Job Instruction Training (JIT).
* Must have the ability to monitor and adjust operating plans and budgets as needed to achieve operational goals, cost reduction objectives, and/or profitability targets.
* Will possess the organizational skills necessary to maintain company records in compliance with the Manufacturing Department and TS16949/ISO 14001 procedures.
* Must be able to work a fixed or rotating shift schedule, including daily or weekend overtime, and have the ability to work a schedule that allows completion of the job on a daily basis.

**Language Skills:** 

* Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand the primary language (English) used in the workplace.

**Computer/Software:** 

* Solid working knowledge and experience with Microsoft Office and other computer-based applications (e.g., MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Outlook, Internet, etc.).
* Working knowledge and experience with ERP/MRP software.

**Travel:** 
Must be willing to travel up to 30% to visit customers, suppliers, and other manufacturing sites.
 
 
North American Stamping Group is a drug-free and smoke-free workplace.

role.title: Sr VP, Operations
role.description:
**Join a Company That’s Redefining Air and Improving Lives**

At Broan-NuTone, we don’t just lead the residential ventilation industry in North America, we’re shaping its future. Through innovation, ingenuity, and a relentless focus on quality, we’re on a mission to be the most trusted and forward-thinking manufacturer of residential ventilation solutions.

Our impact is everywhere: in more than **110 million homes across North America**, where our products help families breathe easier every day. In fact, we move nearly **13 trillion cubic feet of fresh air annually**; a testament to the scale and significance of what we do.

Behind that impact are our **2,000+ entrepreneurs** working across four countries, driven by a shared passion for innovation and excellence. Our products are crafted in our three manufacturing facilities and supported by a network of trusted partners. Together, we bring to life a powerful portfolio of industry-leading brands, including **Broan-NuTone, Zephyr, BEST, and Venmar**.

**A Culture Built on Purpose and Values**

What truly sets us apart is how we work. Our Core Values, **Safety, Trust, Entrepreneurial Spirit, and Bias for Action**, guide every decision we make and every interaction we have. We’re proud to foster a collaborative, high-energy culture where ideas thrive, innovation is encouraged, and people feel empowered to make an impact.

Our purpose is simple yet powerful: **improving lives through better air.** Every product we create is designed to make homes healthier, more comfortable, and longer lasting; helping families flourish and giving professionals solutions they can trust. It’s meaningful work we can stand behind.

**Part of Something Bigger**

Founded in 1932, Broan-NuTone is a cornerstone of **Madison Air**, one of the fastest-growing companies transforming the future of air. In April 2026, Madison Air went public on the New York Stock Exchange (MAIR), reflecting its remarkable growth and momentum. Today, Madison Air includes:

* **8,000+ entrepreneurs worldwide**
* **$10 billion in enterprise value**
* **42 manufacturing facilities across 11 countries**

Together, we’re united by a bold mission: **to make the world safer, healthier, and more productive through the transformative power of air.**

**Ready to make your mark? Join us and help improve lives with better indoor air quality.**

**Business Job Title:** Sr VP - Operations

 

**Job Summary:** The Sr VP - Operations provides global leadership and oversight of Broan-NuTone’s factory operations and supply chain functions. This executive establishes and deploys the global operations and supply chain strategy, drives operational excellence, and determines the most profitable approach for meeting customer demand worldwide. As a member of the Executive Team, the role contributes to company vision and strategy while partnering with Product Development, Marketing, Sales, senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Develop and communicate a three-year global operations and supply chain strategy aligned with the business strategy.
* Lead strategy deployment and continue implementing a formal SIOP process across Broan-NuTone.
* Advise senior leaders on operational and supply chain improvements that strengthen service, cost, quality, and efficiency.
* Develop and implement manufacturing, materials, quality, productivity, and process-improvement plans.
* Own operating budgets, capital plans, cost-reduction initiatives, and monthly, quarterly, and annual operating results.
* Establish global SQDCI metrics and a standardized KPI reporting process.
* Target 98% on-time-and-complete delivery while improving safety, quality, material and labor productivity, and inventory performance.
* Execute global sourcing, logistics, and supply-side initiatives while monitoring manufacturing technology and supply chain trends.
* Align customer requirements, supplier capabilities, and performance metrics with key business objectives.
* Negotiate with and influence supplier partners to support corporate goals and create strategic advantage.
* Champion lean manufacturing and continuous improvement throughout the manufacturing enterprise.
* Design a responsive global operations organization, including supply chain planning, make-versus-buy decisions, and local-market service strategies.
* Build and develop a world-class operations and supply chain team through coaching, succession planning, and external hiring when needed.
* Maintain the technical capabilities required to meet customer and market requirements, with continued emphasis on safety and quality.
* Create a flexible, responsive, metrics-driven culture that can react quickly to changing market conditions.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Management, or a related field required.
* MBA or master’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of successful leadership experience spanning manufacturing, strategic procurement, distribution, and logistics.
* Experience in a high-performing, global, complex durable-consumer-goods manufacturing company with at least $500 million in annual sales.
* Demonstrated responsibility for global operations and supply chain functions.
* Experience leading teams across the United States, Mexico, Asia, and/or Latin America.
* Previous plant leadership experience required.
* Residential or commercial building-products experience—or closely related durable-goods experience—preferred.
* Demonstrated results reducing cost, improving profit, streamlining operations, and producing sustained financial improvement.
* Expertise in lean manufacturing, global supply chain strategy, SIOP, sourcing, logistics, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to operate effectively in an ERP environment.
* Strong collaboration, communication, conflict-management, executive-presence, and influencing skills.
* Strong business judgment, commercial acumen, learning agility, and comfort operating amid ambiguity and change.
* Hands-on, proactive leadership style that balances strategy and innovation with practical, accelerated execution.
* Fact-based and metrics-driven decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop leaders, strengthen succession pipelines, and upgrade organizational capability.
* Ability to travel up to 25%.

*At Broan NuTone, we take pride in offering exceptional benefit packages and a highly competitive pay structure to our employees. Our comprehensive benefits include health, dental and vision insurance, company paid life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, wellness program, education assistance, parental leave, and employee assistance programs. In addition, we provide a competitive pay structure that rewards our employees for their hard work and dedication, ensuring that they are compensated fairly for their contributions. Join our team and enjoy the peace of mind and financial stability that comes with our outstanding benefits and competitive pay.*
