role.title: Director of Operations
role.description:
**Description**

 
 

WORK LOCATION: Huntsville, AL

FLSA STATUS: Exempt

SALARY RANGE: The anticipated salary range for this role is $152,500 to $231,800 annually. This range reflects a good faith estimate based on the targeted level for the role and typical compensation benchmarks across U.S. locations. Actual compensation may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, geographical location, and internal alignment.

SUMMARY

The Director of Operations will oversee all aspects of production within the organization, ensuring efficient processes, high-quality output, and adherence to safety and AS9100 quality management standards. This leadership role involves strategic planning, resource management, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to optimize production performance and meet business objectives in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will have significant experience leading operations within the aerospace, defense, advanced technology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries, with a demonstrated ability to scale operations, improve performance, and support complex product development and production environments.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The following job functions are a basic requirement but are not limited to and may be assigned other duties.

* Develop and implement operational strategies that align with the company’s goals and objectives, focusing on enhancing production efficiency and reducing costs.
* Manage the entire production process, including scheduling, resource allocation, and workflow optimization, to ensure timely delivery of products while maintaining quality standards.
* Establish and uphold quality assurance protocols to ensure compliance with AS9100 standards, customer requirements, regulatory obligations, and internal quality management system requirements. Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability. Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide constructive feedback.
* Identify areas for operational improvement and implement best practices, methodologies (such as Lean or Six Sigma), and technologies to optimize production processes and enhance productivity.
* Drive a culture of quality, operational excellence, accountability, and customer satisfaction throughout the manufacturing organization.
* Work closely with supply chain, engineering, quality assurance, and sales teams to ensure alignment and effective communication regarding production schedules, inventory management, and customer requirements.
* Develop and manage the operations budget, ensuring resources are allocated effectively to support production goals while minimizing waste and controlling costs.
* Promote a safe working environment by ensuring adherence to safety regulations and protocols, conducting training sessions, and addressing any safety concerns promptly.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor production efficiency, quality, and safety. Analyze data and prepare reports for senior management to inform decision-making.
* Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to ensure the timely delivery of materials and components, negotiating contracts and terms to optimize costs and quality.
* Develop contingency plans to address potential disruptions in production, such as equipment failures, supply chain delays, or workforce shortages, ensuring minimal impact on operations.
* Assumes all other responsibilities as assigned

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive operations leadership experience within aerospace, defense, advanced technology, electronics, precision manufacturing, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience leading complex manufacturing operations supporting government and commercial customers is strongly preferred. Proven track record of successfully managing production processes and driving operational excellence.
* Strong knowledge of aerospace manufacturing principles, AS9100 quality management systems, quality control processes, regulatory compliance requirements, and safety regulations. Demonstrated experience operating within an AS9100-certified manufacturing environment.
* Excellent leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire staff at all levels.
* Proficient in data analysis and performance metrics, with experience using ERP and production management software.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Experience with Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.

REDWIRE DEFENSE TECH BENEFITS

* Matching 401(k)
* Paid PTO
* Paid holidays
* Medical, vision, and dental insurance
* Group Short-Term & Long-Term Disability
* HSA and FSA Options
* Critical Care Plan
* Accident Care Plan
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS

This position may require access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). To comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants will be asked to provide specific documentation to verify a US person’s status under the ITAR and the EAR.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The work environment may involve a standard office setting while also incorporating elements of a production area. Employees will use standard office equipment, including computers, and must demonstrate stamina to sit or stand while maintaining attention to detail despite potential interruptions. The role may require occasional activities such as walking, climbing, stooping, crouching, and bending. Vision is necessary for reading printed materials and a computer screen, while hearing and speech are essential for effective communication both in person and over the telephone. Additionally, the position may necessitate travel by air or automobile. Employees may be required to use personal protective equipment, including safety glasses, safety shoes, and shop coats, to ensure safety in the production environment. Employees may be able to lift up to 30 pounds as needed.

REDWIRE DEFENSE TECH IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Redwire Defense Tech is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact Human Resources. Continued employment remains on an “At-Will” basis.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
R10104082 Plant Manager (Open)

Location:

Carnegie, PA

**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the unique perspectives of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders, and cultures across the world. We believe that a variety of backgrounds makes our team stronger and more innovative.

**At Airgas, we RESPECT, HONOR and VALUE diversity.**
=====================================================

 

**Airgas is Hiring for a Plant Manager in Carnegie, PA**
========================================================

 

***We are looking for you !***

 

* **Comprehensive Family Benefits:** Airgas offers a full benefits package designed to support your whole life, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance.
* **Support for Parents:** We offer a 14-week paid child birth benefit to support growing families.
* **Future Security:** 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, Tuition Assistance, Paid Holidays, Vacation, and Sick time.
* **Early Access:** Your benefits start after just 30 days of employment.

 

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading and empowering the team engaged in producing and repackaging of compressed and liquid gases into cylinders, correcting unsafe acts or conditions without delay, and aligning daily responsibilities with team members according to customer needs, current stock levels and team strengths.

* Ensures the safe operation and maintenance of the plant for pumping or repackaging of gases into cylinders while ensuring compliance with all federal, state, local and company policies, procedures, regulations and laws. Maintains a neat, clean and orderly plant appearance.
* Studies production schedules and estimates team-hour requirements for completion of job assignments. Establishes and/or adjusts work procedures collaboratively to meet production schedules.
* Partners with the team to enhance production methods, equipment performance, and product quality. Adapts workflows and use of equipment to support team productivity and well-being.
* Ensures all safety rules are strictly observed and safety training is regularly scheduled, conducted and documented. Interpret company policies to team members and foster a culture of safety adherence.
* Ensures all injuries and accidents are properly investigated and reported within 24 hours.
* Analyzes and resolves, or partners with team members in solving, work related problems. Supports career growth, internal movement, and constructive performance management. Ensures associate issues, grievances, etc. are effectively handled.
* Mentors and guides operational leaders to cultivate effective leadership. Design collaborative initiatives to inspire and engage the team to achieve goals. Provides coaching and corrective action promptly, to ensure that team members receiving feedback are supported to meet shared performance goals.
* Onboards new team members and supports cross-functional learning to continue production during personnel shortages.
* Maintains time and production records and approves overtime when essential, while keeping overtime at acceptable levels.
* Collaborates with outside sales to ensure order accuracy and properly scheduled customer deliveries by Airgas trucks.
* Monitors SAP reports daily such as open order/delivery reports, billing and delivery block reports and open Purchase Order (PO) reports.
* Oversees employee development in procedural areas such as following all Airgas Standard Operating Procedures (SOPS) and safety regulations.
* Run recurring orders for the next day's deliveries.
* Route all the trucks and PGI tickets.
* Complete Daily Cycle Counts.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**
----------------------------------------------------

**Are you a MATCH?**
--------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or GED
* A total of five (5) years of industry experience to include a minimum of two (2) years of demonstrated experience working in a supervisory/leadership role. Prefer prior experience with compressed/packaged gases.

**Prefered Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree
* Prior experience utilizing SAP preferred.
* Intermediate knowledge of Google suite applications
* Strong analytical skills and a thorough understanding of how to leverage metrics and related tools to improve production efficiency and effectiveness.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Communication skills that ensure a smooth flow of information between self and others through clear speaking and writing, encouragement of open expression of ideas, and effective listening.

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to deal effectively with others in both favorable and unfavorable situations regardless of status of position. Accepts cultural diversity and establishes effective working relationships.
* Demonstrated knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division in all units of measure using whole numbers, fractions and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratios, and percent.

* Lives by Airgas safety programs, OSHA, and all related rules, regulations, procedures which are applicable to this position’s responsibilities

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Benefits**

We care about and support our Airgas Families. This is evident not only through our competitive compensation but also through a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision plans, short-term and long-term disability, life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), pre-tax commuter transportation benefit, parental leave, vacation, sick time, floating holidays, jury duty and funeral/bereavement leave, and paid holidays for all eligible full-time employees.

Additionally, we offer our eligible employees a 401k plan with company matching funds, tuition reimbursement, discounted college tuition for eligible employees’ dependents, and an Airgas Scholarship Program for dependent children.

Associates who are members of collective bargaining units should review their bargaining agreement to determine whether they are eligible for some or all of the benefits described here and to see any special terms or conditions for eligibility.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Your DIFFERENCES enhance our PERFORMANCE**

At Airgas, we are committed to building a workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability or any other protected characteristic. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**About Airgas**

Airgas, an Air Liquide company, is a leading U.S. supplier of industrial, medical and specialty gases, as well as hardgoods and related products; one of the largest U.S. suppliers of safety products; and a leading U.S. supplier of ammonia products and process chemicals. Through the passion and diversity of its 18,000 associates, Airgas fosters a culture of safety, customer success, sustainability and innovation. Airgas associates are empowered to share ideas, take initiative and make decisions.

Airgas is a subsidiary of Air Liquide, a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare. Present in 60 countries with approximately 66,500 employees, Air Liquide serves more than 4 million customers and patients.

Join us for a stimulating experience: At Airgas, you matter and so does the work you do. As a member of our team, you play an important role in the success of your team, making sure our products are created sustainably and delivered safely and efficiently. In turn, you’ll find a welcoming workplace where you’re valued for who you are and where you can fill your potential while growing a fulfilling career — whatever path you choose.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Equal Employment Opportunity Information**

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Airgas, an Air Liquide Company is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973.

Airgas does not discriminate against qualified applicants with disabilities, and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to the known disabilities of such individuals so as to ensure equal access to benefits and privileges of employment. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us by email at us-accommodationrequest@airgas.com.

11-15-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager will direct the activities of the plant employees in a safe, compliant, reliable, and economical manner including electric power production, maintenance, engineering, construction, accounting, procurement, materials management, human resources, public affairs, tax matters and compliance with regulating agencies. Responsible for establishing and maintaining two-way communications with employees, managers and the general public. Provide leadership and manage change by the development of a culture that promotes/supports teamwork, process improvement activities, employee development, and proper recognition and reward.

**Job Description**

**What You'll Do:**

 

* Plan, organize, coordinate, direct and control plant activities including the operation, maintenance, engineering and construction of the plant's facilities in a safe, efficient and economical manner.
* Support the System Safety Process. Develop, maintain and enforce safe working conditions by providing proper and adequate tools, equipment, protective clothing and devices, and training. Establish and enforce safe work behaviors. Participate in the setting of safety goals for an accident-free work environment. Communicate to employees about the importance of a safe work environment on a daily basis. Investigate, report and track incidents/accidents including root cause analysis and corrective action taken. Report findings to management and to employees.
* Develop long range plans for maintenance and operational excellence, capital improvements, equipment availability, cultural transformation, and the plant organization's succession planning requirements.
* Direct long range planning activities including maintenance management, materials management, QA/QC, human resources, accounting, predictive and preventative maintenance systems, and public relations.
* Develop short range (three years to coincide with the investment review committee) plan and forecasts in cooperation with engineering and maintenance personnel; develop budgets, prepare variance reports and control expenditures to meet approved budgets.
* Direct the operation of plant activities to ensure compliance with all local, state and federal laws and regulations and compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Participate in the formulation of company policies and procedures pertaining to plant operations.
* Establish and maintain close liaison with city, county, local and other officials and industrial leaders, and inform appropriate persons of actions, proposals and plans that have a bearing on plant operations and activities.

**What We're Looking For:**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, business management; or associate degree in a technical field, chemistry, environmental services, accounting, or equivalent applied knowledge (see experience).

Experience: Minimum of 8 years' experience including work in plant operations, maintenance, and performance areas. Experience should include business/financial and human resources administration. A minimum of eight years supervising others. OTHER REQUIREMENTS: Physical demand level is Sedentary.

Training should include company courses in leadership, supervision, change-management, team skills, problem solving & decision making, process improvement, safety, business skills and other relevant courses.

**What You’ll Get:**

In addition to a competitive compensation, AEP offers a unique comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.

**Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do!**

At AEP, we’re more than just an energy company — we’re a team of dedicated professionals committed to delivering safe, reliable, and innovative energy solutions. Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and being part of a forward-thinking organization, this is the company for you!

role.title: Plant Manager/ CDL Mixer Operator - Ready Mix Concrete
role.description:
About the Opportunity:

We are seeking a hands-on Plant Manager / CDL Mixer Operator to oversee the daily operations of our ready mix concrete plant while also operating a concrete mixer truck as business demands require. This is a working management position ideal for someone who enjoys leading a team, maintaining efficient plant operations, and providing excellent customer service in the field.

The successful candidate will ensure safe, efficient production and delivery of quality concrete while maintaining high standards for customer service, equipment maintenance, and regulatory compliance.

Your Mission & Key Responsibilities:

* ### **Plant Operations**

 + Oversee daily batching and production of ready mix concrete.
 + Schedule production and deliveries to meet customer needs.
 + Supervise plant employees and coordinate daily work assignments.
 + Monitor inventory of cement, aggregates, admixtures, and other materials.
 + Ensure quality control standards are maintained.
 + Coordinate equipment maintenance and repairs to minimize downtime.
 + Maintain a clean, organized, and safe plant environment.
 + Ensure compliance with OSHA, DOT, environmental, and company safety policies.
 + Complete production reports and maintain accurate operational records.

 ### **CDL Mixer Operations**

 + Operate a ready mix concrete mixer truck (Class A or Class B CDL) when needed.
 + Safely transport and deliver concrete to commercial and residential job sites.
 + Perform pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections.
 + Maintain delivery documentation and DOT compliance.
 + Communicate effectively with dispatch, customers, and job site personnel.
 + Assist with plant and yard duties during downtime.

What Sets You Apart:

* Valid Class A or Class B CDL with current DOT Medical Card required.
* Previous ready mix concrete plant management or supervisory experience preferred.
* Experience operating a concrete mixer truck.
* Knowledge of batching systems and concrete production.
* Strong leadership and organizational skills.
* Excellent customer service and communication abilities.
* Commitment to safety and regulatory compliance.
* Mechanical aptitude with the ability to identify and troubleshoot equipment issues.
* Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Ability to climb ladders, lift up to 100 pounds, and perform physical job duties as needed.

About SRM:

SRM Concrete (Smyrna Ready Mix) is a family-owned, values-driven leader in the ready mix concrete industry. Founded in 1999 with a single plant in Smyrna, Tennessee, we’ve grown to over 600 locations nationwide by focusing on quality, integrity, and service. Our mission is to serve our customers, our communities, and our team members with excellence—every load, every day.Why Join SRM Concrete?

**Why Join SRM Concrete?**

* **Growth & Advancement:** Be part of a rapidly expanding company with real opportunities to grow your career.
* **Impact:** Lead a team that plays a pivotal role in building America’s future.
* **Competitive Pay & Exceptional Benefits:** Low-cost medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance; paid holidays; PTO/vacation; 401k with $100 weekly match; family days; and more!
* **Team Culture:** We value hard work, respect, and teamwork. We support each other, recognize a job well done, and believe in doing what’s right—on the job and in the community. You’ll find a straightforward, dependable environment where every team member matters.

At SRM Concrete, you’re more than a manager—you’re a valued team member helping to build America’s future. If you’re ready to say “YES” to new opportunities and deliver service that sets the standard in our industry, apply today and join the SRM family!

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Plant manager will provide leadership and direction to ensure the continual, efficient and uniform operation which will meet or exceed customer expectations in a safe and orderly manner.
 
He/she will develop and implement plans coordinated with the Corporate Business Plan to increase the reliability and continually improve the quality and efficiencies of the products and services provided by the business unit.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Supervise branch production using RMAS Warehouse Management System and available Production Planning tools
* Develop plans and procedures to insure the safety of all employees and visitors of the warehouse and Clarify and correct any incorrect warehouse procedures
* Ensure operations and equipment is in compliance to corporate guidelines and OSHA Standards
* Verify inventory and make adjustments where necessary
* Hire, train and motivate warehouse employees to build bench strength and increase retention by scheduling and provide training for growth and compliance
* Maintain equipment to provide maximum availability and minimum down time
* Evaluate and recommend new equipment purchases to enhance quality, capabilities and productivity
* Communicate and monitor progress towards company safety, returns and allowances, and on time shipment and delivery directives
* Responsible for building maintenance and security
* Monitor quality and process improvement throughout the warehouse using SAP reports
* Ensure that preventive and corrective action methods are followed to eliminate or correct procedures and practices which do not meet customer requirements
* Follow progressive disciplinary action to adhere to policy and procedures
* Ensure adequate support of the sales department and its customers in a timely and orderly manner
* Assist with customer problems, including on-site visits where necessary
* Facilitate Lean practices in the Plant
* Purchase or direct the purchase of necessary warehouse supplies to insure the ability to comply with written work instructions and customer requirements
* Attend regional and corporate meetings when required
* Perform employee reviews as required
* Assist in contract negotiations, where applicable
* This is a position that works directly on the warehouse floor on or around heavy machinery
* Meets TKMNA Employee Attributes/Competencies

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirement for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

**This position has been identified as** **“safety sensitive”** **by thyssenkrupp under applicable laws. Accordingly, any application for this position that is considered for employment with thyssenkrupp requires successful completion of pre-employment drug testing, which may include testing for marijuana in accordance with any applicable federal, state, and local laws.**

**Qualifications:**

Minimum Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree preferred (in a Business, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Behavioral Science curriculum)
* Two years direct Warehouse Supervision or team leadership, experience
* Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Office application, Excel, Word, Access and PowerPoint a must
* An understanding of Basic Lean Manufacturing Principles
* Safety Mindset

Preferred Requirements:

* MBA, Master’s degree or Ph.D. is a plus
* Exposure to labor relations, safety programs, ISO standards, Lean practices and sale functions.

role.description:
**Lead Operations. Build Teams. Drive Growth.**

Are you a hands-on operations leader who thrives on building high-performing teams, improving processes, and delivering results? UFP Factory Built is looking for a Plant Manager to lead one of our manufacturing facilities and play a key role in the success of our growing business.

 

As a Plant Manager, you'll have the opportunity to run the operation like it's your own, leading production, safety, quality, inventory, maintenance, and team development while making a direct impact on profitability and customer satisfaction. This is an ideal role for a leader who enjoys solving problems, developing people, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**About UFP Factory Built**

UFP Factory Built, a division of UFP Industries, supplies structural components and engineered solutions for manufactured housing, modular construction, RV, and cargo trailer manufacturers throughout North America. We are part of a stable, growth-oriented organization with a strong reputation for investing in our people and promoting from within.

 

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead all day-to-day plant operations, ensuring safety, quality, productivity, and profitability goals are achieved.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of supervisors and production employees.
* Drive operational excellence through process improvements, waste reduction, and efficiency initiatives.
* Manage production scheduling, inventory levels, shipping activities, and resource planning.
* Monitor key performance metrics and take action to improve throughput, quality, and financial results.
* Partner with leadership on capital investments, facility improvements, and business growth initiatives.
* Foster a culture centered around safety, employee engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, OSHA standards, and all applicable regulations.
Oversee maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime. 

 

### **What We're Looking For**

* Experience leading manufacturing, production, operations, or industrial teams.
* Proven ability to motivate employees, develop talent, and drive results.
* Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, costs, and operational metrics.
* Ability to identify opportunities, solve problems, and implement effective solutions.
* Experience with inventory management, production scheduling, and process improvement.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Forklift certification or willingness to obtain certification. 

 

### **Why Join UFP?**

* Opportunity to lead and influence all aspects of a manufacturing operation.
* High visibility and direct impact on business performance.
* Stable and growing company with a strong national footprint.
* Collaborative culture that values leadership, innovation, and accountability.
* Career advancement opportunities within UFP Industries.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package. 

 

### **What Success Looks Like**

In this role, you'll build a safe, efficient, and engaged operation, develop future leaders, improve plant performance, and help position the facility for continued growth. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, the support of an experienced leadership team, and the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on the business.

 

**If you're a driven operations leader looking to take ownership of a facility, develop teams, and grow your career with an industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Benefits** **currently offered to our employees:**

* Medical Insurance
* Health Savings Account with Company Contribution
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* 401(k) plan with Company Match
* Paid Vacation and Holidays
* Stock Purchase Program with Employee Discount
* Education Reimbursement
* Wellness Programs and Challenges
Other Supplemental Benefits 

*The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

role.description:
About the Opportunity:

Are you a proven leader who thrives on building strong teams and delivering exceptional service? At SRM Concrete, our Plant Managers are the driving force behind our commitment to operational excellence and customer satisfaction. As a Plant Manager, you’ll lead by example—empowering your team, optimizing daily operations, and ensuring every load meets the highest standards of safety, quality, and service.

If you’re passionate about leadership, logistics, and making a positive impact in your community, this is your opportunity to join a company that values integrity, teamwork, and growth.

Your Mission & Key Responsibilities:

* Lead with purpose: Inspire, coach, and develop your plant team to achieve operational excellence and deliver outstanding service to every customer.
* Oversee daily plant operations: Manage staff scheduling, load planning, and route optimization to ensure efficient and timely concrete deliveries.
* Champion customer service: Collaborate with drivers, dispatch, and sales teams to exceed customer expectations and resolve any issues with urgency and care.
* Drive performance: Implement and monitor key metrics to assess plant efficiency, productivity, and service quality.
* Foster a culture of safety: Ensure full compliance with safety regulations and company policies, creating a safe and positive work environment for all.
* Promote teamwork: Conduct regular meetings to review performance, address challenges, and celebrate successes.
* Build relationships: Develop strong connections with customers, suppliers, and SRM team members to support seamless operations.
* Contribute to growth: Participate in strategic planning and budgeting, sharing insights to enhance plant efficiency and profitability.

What Sets You Apart:

* Inspirational leadership style with a passion for developing high-performing teams.
* Commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and building lasting relationships.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills; able to prioritize and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
* Deep understanding of logistics, supply chain management, or plant operations—experience in the concrete or construction industry is highly valued.
* Proficiency with dispatch software, Microsoft Office Suite, and a willingness to learn new systems.
* Knowledge of DOT regulations and safety standards for transportation and delivery.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; you build trust with team members, customers, and partners.
* Dedication to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Willingness to undergo SRM’s pre-employment screenings.

About SRM:

SRM Concrete (Smyrna Ready Mix) is a family-owned, values-driven leader in the ready mix concrete industry. Founded in 1999 with a single plant in Smyrna, Tennessee, we’ve grown to over 600 locations nationwide by focusing on quality, integrity, and service. Our mission is to serve our customers, our communities, and our team members with excellence—every load, every day.Why Join SRM Concrete?

**Why Join SRM Concrete?**

* **Growth & Advancement:** Be part of a rapidly expanding company with real opportunities to grow your career.
* **Impact:** Lead a team that plays a pivotal role in building America’s future.
* **Competitive Pay & Exceptional Benefits:** Low-cost medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance; paid holidays; PTO/vacation; 401k with $100 weekly match; family days; and more!
* **Team Culture:** We value hard work, respect, and teamwork. We support each other, recognize a job well done, and believe in doing what’s right—on the job and in the community. You’ll find a straightforward, dependable environment where every team member matters.

At SRM Concrete, you’re more than a manager—you’re a valued team member helping to build America’s future. If you’re ready to say “YES” to new opportunities and deliver service that sets the standard in our industry, apply today and join the SRM family!

role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**PURPOSE:**

* Supervise the production of donated and new goods, assuring all personnel are properly trained in all areas of the production process.
* Maintain production standards and quotas for supplying all agency stores with saleable merchandise.
* Maintain inventory production records.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

Coordinates the following:

* Trains production associates to develop proficiency in providing proper classification of donated material and new goods.
* Evaluates the performance of workers and makes recommendations for changes if necessary.
* Monitor quality of processed clothing, wares, shoes, purses, books, etc. by spot checking racks and totes being distributed to stores. Monitor processed clothing for damage due to improper tagging.
* Monitor processed clothing and housewares for Consumer Product Safety Commission recalls.
* Monitor Falls Creek processing for safety issues.
* Maintain Kaizen implementation by conducting monthly Falls Creek Kaizen audits.
* Promptly report all instances of safety, and recall issues to responsible individual. Retrain individual on proper quality standards, safety policies, and CPSC guidelines.
* Sort’s incoming material into predetermined category, sends sorted materials to storage or proper activity or processing.
* Follows style trends to determine classifications of articles.
* Prepares and maintains records as directed.
* Takes note of any unusual or valuable items received.
* Assists in establishing performance standards for associates.
* Develops and trains to meet standards.
* Assures that all machines and equipment are used properly.
* Responsible for all safety and accident functions.
* Assures housekeeping and grounds keeping is attended.
* Orders supplies directly related to production.
* Keeps President and CEO informed on supply of unprocessed material.
* Assists in all production and transportation aspects.
* Must be able to stand for long periods of time, use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; push or pull.
* Must be able to occasionally sit, kneel, and climb.
* Must be able to regularly stoop, bend, squat, reach tum and twist body and lift up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.

**RELATIONS:**

* Works under the general supervision of the President and CEO with authority to make minor decisions within established policies and procedures.
* Refers major decisions to the President and CEO.
* Works closely with Director of Mission Services and Program Specialist to ensure full integration of referrals into the workforce.
* Works closely with Warehouse Manager to ensure efficient flow of product to retail stores and required inventory of product is readily available for processing.

**STANDARDS FOR MEASURING PERFORMANCE:**

* The ability to meet or exceed cost and performance standards.
* The manner in which all material is processed.
* Effectiveness and detecting and safeguarding valuable or unusual items.
* Adequacy and accuracy of records.
* Degree to which respect and confidence of co-workers is established.
* Quality, quantity, and timeliness in the performance of assigned tasks.
* The manner in which one conduct reflects the high standards of morals and integrity expected of all Goodwill associates.
* Ability to meet deadlines and respond to special requests and the desires of management.

Benefits after 90 days include: agency paid life insurance and vision insurance, vacation, sick, holidays, and eligible to participate in group health and dental programs with biweekly co-pay. EOE

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school graduate or equivalent with prior management and supervisory experience.
* Must have good work habits and respond appropriately to supervision.
* Must possess adequate physical endurance to work at industrial standards.
* Must have a valid PA Driver's License and clean MVR, and clean Criminal History, Child Abuse, and Fingerprint Clearances.

role.title: Plant Manager (South County WWTP)
role.description:
**Job Overview**

Manages plants and directs and supervises the activities of personnel engaged in Advanced Water Reclamation, Potable Water supply distribution systems and solids management to ensure proper utility service to County residents and property owners.

**Annual Salary Range- $93,600.00- $125,257.60**

***Internal rates may vary based on the selected candidate's current grade.***

***Ideal Candidate***

The ideal candidate is an experienced Class “A” Florida Wastewater Treatment Plant Manager or Supervisor with exceptional leadership skills. The candidate would possess extensive knowledge of wastewater process control strategies and would have exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills, with an ability to make sound and logical corrective actions. The candidate would possess maintenance experience which would allow them to make minor repairs or modifications as needed. The candidate would be well organized, utilizing calendars and reminders to aid themselves and subordinates in completing tasks. The candidate would possess the ability to plan and direct operational duties for his team or shift; cleaning duties, special projects, overtime, and maintenance. The successful candidate would be a highly motivated, self-starter possessing extensive motivational skills and exceptional teaching skills. The ideal candidate would utilize delegation as a tool to teach their subordinates and prepare them for succession. The candidate would have the ability to set up and facilitate staff meetings, safety meetings, and tailgate meetings before work. A good listener while also being a great communicator both orally and written as well as maintain detailed records and logs of duties and logistical data. The candidate would follow up on work performed in the plant, always communicating changes and status updates to the chain of command. Candidates should be able to safely and comfortably work with various industrial and laboratory chemicals. Candidates must be able and willing to respond to emergency situations to provide for public health and safety. Though the work consists of a team atmosphere, candidates at times will be required to work independently, occasionally work rotating shifts, including nights, weekends and holidays as well as cover overtime as needed. Candidates should have extensive computer skills with standard software such as Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, etc.

**Core Competencies**

* ***Customer Commitment*** - Proactively seeks to understand the needs of the customers and provide the highest standards of service.
* ***Dedication to Professionalism and Integrity*** - Demonstrates and promotes fair, honest, professional and ethical behaviors that establishes trust throughout the organization and with the public we serve.
* ***Organizational Excellence*** - Takes ownership for excellence through one's personal effectiveness and dedication to the continuous improvement of our operations.
* ***Success through Teamwork*** - Collaborates and builds partnerships through trust and the open exchange of diverse ideas and perspectives to achieve organizational goals.

***Duties and Responsibilities***

Note: The following duties are illustrative and not exhaustive. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to the position. Depending on assigned area of responsibility, incumbents in the position may perform some or all of the activities described below.

* Plans and makes recommendations for short, intermediate and long-term needs associated with the biennial budgeting process.
* Manages the work of subordinate staff by scheduling, assigning and reviewing work, providing training and counseling and evaluating performance.
* Trains subordinates in all aspects of job duties and responsibilities to achieve unit and organizational goals.
* Monitors, inspects, and analyzes all aspects of water and wastewater plant operations and maintenance for compliance with permit specifications.
* Conducts facility inspections with regulatory program enforcement officers and bond engineers to ensure compliance with permit specifications.
* Reviews and approves daily, weekly and monthly detailed operations reports and maintenance records.
* Notifies manager and/or other appropriate staff of needs for non-routine adjustments and/or malfunctioning of equipment.
* Develops, reviews, and updates standard operating procedures for facility processes, safety, and/or malfunctioning of equipment.
* Develops, reviews, and updates standard operating procedures for facility processes, safety, and emergency conditions to ensure proper and safe operations of facilities.
* Serves as the custodian of record for all fiscal assets located at a facility and conducts quarterly and annual in-house inventories.
* Oversees work performed by contractors, verifies that work is performed in accordance with contract terms, and recommends payment of pay requests.
* Evaluates unit performance, equipment condition and process systems for repair/replacement, budgeting, future planning and plant reliability needs.
* Conducts and attends meetings to disseminate and receive information.
* Notifies necessary personnel and responds accordingly in emergency situations such as floods, hurricanes, tornadoes and other natural and/or unnatural crises to provide for public health and safety.
* Manages and approves routine and non-routine adjustments to controls in conformance with operating instructions, Florida Administrative Code, and prescribed standards.
* Attends and participates in all design and pre-construction meetings providing vital input assisting the Engineering Group with plant expansions, upgrade and rehab projects.
* Performs other related duties as required.

***Job Specifications***

* Knowledge of the operation and maintenance of Advanced Water Reclamation, Potable Water supply, distribution systems, and solids management and related equipment.
* Knowledge of principles, practices and methods of water treatment, water reclamation, facility administration and regulation.
* Knowledge of effective managerial principles and practices.
* Knowledge of industrial mechanical methods relating to installation, maintenance and repair of water, wastewater and reclaim water process equipment.
* Knowledge of budget preparation and administration.
* Knowledge of department procedure and guidelines.
* Ability to perform assigned duties with considerable independence.
* Ability to plan, direct, and coordinate work of subordinates.
* Ability to prepare and interpret plans, specifications, blueprints, schematics, etc. pertaining to plant expansions and improvements.
* Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.
* Ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with employees, officials, regulatory agency representatives, and the general public.
* Ability and willingness to respond to emergency situations such as floods, hurricanes, tornadoes and other natural and/or unnatural crises to provide for public health and safety.
* Ability and willingness to work overtime, rotating shifts, including nights, weekends and holidays.
* Ability to use a computer and related software.

***Physical Requirements***

* The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

***Work Category***

* **Medium work** - Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

***Minimum Qualifications Required***

* Graduation from an accredited four-year degree granting college or university; AND
* Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in plant operations including leading or working in a team environment; and 2 years of supervisory experience in a Water/Wastewater plant environment; OR
* An equivalent combination of education (not less than a high school diploma/GED), training, and experience that would reasonably be expected to provide the job-related competencies noted above; AND
* Possession of a valid State of Florida Water or Wastewater Plant Operator "A" Certificate of License; AND
* Possession of a valid Florida Driver’s license.

***Emergency Management Responsibilities***

In the event of an emergency or disaster, an employee may be required to respond promptly to duties and responsibilities as assigned by the employee’s department, the County’s Office of Emergency Management, or County Administration. Such assignments may be for before, during or after the emergency/disaster.

role.description:
Join a growing, stable company offering consistent hours, and strong benefits. Gas and Supply is the region’s largest independent distributor of welding, safety, and industrial supplies, as well as a top national distributor of industrial, medical, and cryogenic gases. With over fifty locations across seven states, we are seeking a motivated individual to become a part of our team as a Fill Plant Manager.

**What’s in it for you:**

* Competitive wages commensurate with experience
* Regular overtime
* Monday – Friday work week (some Saturdays as needed)
* Bonus opportunities
* Career advancement opportunities
* Employer-paid life insurance
* Employer-paid disability insurance
* Health, dental, and vision insurance available
* 401K with employer match
* Educational reimbursement program
* Generous personal leave policy

**Job Description**:

Our Fill Plant Manager is responsible for supervising activities and workers engaged in the repackaging of compressed gas and liquid gases into cylinders. They will also be responsible for assigning job tasks to workers according to customer needs, stocking levels and other branch needs. Additional tasks may be assigned depending on the workload.

**Job Duties:**

* Operate and safely maintain equipment for pumping or repackaging gases into cylinders.

role.title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
role.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

-------------------

**The Role**
============

Lead the development and deployment of quality processes and communications with the assigned region; drive quality culture, competent decision-making, appropriate risk assessments, and timely remediation of situations. Maintain frequent and open communications with executive and corporate leaders that focus on timely resolution of issues that may potentially affect the safety, quality, identity, purity, and/or potency of collected plasma. Review and monitor Quality metrics and reports for trends and opportunities for improvement.

 

**Reports To**: Sr. Director, Quality Assurance
 
**Direct Reports:** Assistant Manager of Quality (Approximately 6-7)

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

 
 

* Manage staff, including selecting, training, developing, coaching and terminating, as applicable with guidance from Human Resources. Appraise employee performance and provide feedback and counseling to staff, as applicable.
* Manage compliance to and successful use of the Quality System tools such as change and deviations management.
 
 Ensure regular management review of quality performance that delivers stable, high levels of compliance performance in assigned QA areas. Provide leadership and coordination to established automated systems for control.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) performance to ensure meeting regulatory and departmental requirements, and to drive continual improvement in department processes. Works with CSL applicable systems to analyze and identify significant quality issues/trends and reports those to appropriate Sr. Management. Provides routine reports on the quality KPIs as requested by the applicable business units.
* Maintain understanding of all policies and procedures. Participate in and may lead the development of functional policies and SOPs for assigned areas
* Establish, implement and ensure timely delivery of strategic Quality Assurance performance. Provide direction and guidance on quality topics including resolutions and corrective actions. Perform LSW above center visits. Ensure deployment and sustainability of in-center LSW practices to assigned region.
* Develop & maintain process to disseminate quality interpretation & strategies to operationalize relevant regulations, guidance & standards in collaboration with stakeholders. Maintain & update Quality training materials and provide consistent technical guidance to the operations team. Develop, deploy and occasionally deliver Quality information/publications to appropriate Corporate or Center staff.
* Mentor others on data analysis, technical problem prevention and resolution, design control procedures, investigation processes, and methods to arrive at true root causes as it relates to quality systems.
* Maintain high level of regulatory, compliance and communications skills with department staff, ensuring competence to make decisions and judgments in the course of business, including times of uncertainty.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, to support business needs.
 

 

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Science, Business Administration or Quality Management required; or
* Minimum 8 years equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Fluency in English/Spanish

**Experience**

* 5+ years’ experience successfully serving in a leadership role within an FDA-regulated or other regulated industry required
* Minimum 2 years managing people preferred
* Experience in leading projects to a successful conclusion
* Understand regulatory standards, various local, state, and federal laws that apply to the business and where to find information on standards and interpretations
* Computer literate with knowledge of word processing and spreadsheets
* Excellent critical reasoning, decision-making, and problem-solving skills to analyze situations, determine risks, find solutions to prevent future issues, and resolve recurring defects
* Strong leadership, training, written and verbal communication, and interpersonal and presentation skills to drive results
* Organizational skills and ability to manage projects involving multiple tasks by a team with deadlines.
* Good leadership and people management skills are essential in the success of leading project teams.
* Establish solid working relationships with to interface with and support senior management, third parties and other positions and circumstances within the organization
* Excellent customer service orientation with flexibility and adaptability to work as a member of the team and respond quickly to changes as required by the business operations
* Maintain a professional demeanor and handle confidential information with discretion
Lead teams without the benefit of a direct reporting relationship 

**Additional Comments**

The person selected for this position **will need to live/relocate to Puerto Rico**; they will be responsible for above-center quality leadership of all centers on the island.

**Working Conditions (physical & mental requirements)**

* Ability to make decisions which have significant impact on the department’s credibility, operations and services
* Ability to formulate complex and comprehensive materials such as authoritative reports of major scope and impact, etc. and/or to make formal presentations
* Exercise good judgment to refer decisions to management when decisions fall out of the realm of established guidelines
* Overnight travel required up to 50% of the time
* Frequent standing and walking
* Ability to lift or carry up to 25 lbs.
Fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions

role.title: Senior Manager, Performance and Quality
role.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

As the Senior Manager, Performance and Quality, you'll lead proposal development and formal client responses for the account, and coordinate the team's responses to client, external, and government audits. You'll turn complex contract, pricing, performance guarantee, and operational requirements into accurate, persuasive, on-time submissions. Every commitment and audit response you produce is supported, traceable, and clear to the client. In Finance and Contract Compliance, you'll link what proposals promise to how performance and quality are checked through audits and corrective action. You will also project-manage implementations and changes on the account.

**Primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develop proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, client-requested program and benefit-change proposals, and contract amendments that align with account objectives and client requirements.
* Manage the end-to-end development and submission of proposals and formal client responses, from requirement intake through final review and delivery.
* Partner with account, executive, Finance, Legal, Clinical, and Operations leadership to define key messages and value propositions, and confirm that pricing, performance guarantee, and contract commitments are accurate and approved before submission.
* Write clear, persuasive, client-ready narratives and executive communications about capabilities, program results, and positions, and represent the team in client meetings on proposals and deliverables.
* Lead project management for implementations and account changes, such as new programs, vendor transitions, and benefit or system changes. Build and manage project plans for these and for RFPs, renewals, contract amendments, client deliverables, and audit responses, with timelines, milestones, owners, and dependencies. Plan for compressed client turnaround times and escalate at-risk items early.
* Research client needs, program developments, and market and competitive trends to inform proposal strategy and client recommendations.
* Implement standardized templates, content libraries, style guides, and quality checklists for proposals and audit responses, and train contributors to use them.
* Support contract negotiations during RFPs and amendments by coordinating redlines and negotiating items with Legal and leadership, and documenting each decision to keep, trade, or drop an item, with its approver, so the rationale stays on record.
* Own the audit request log and coordinate intake, scoping, ownership, and evidence production for client, external, and government audits of the account, including third-party audits triggered by performance guarantee escalation provisions.
* Perform quality reviews of audit responses and evidence packages to confirm every part of the request is addressed, amounts reconcile, and the response is clear to an independent reviewer; coordinate secure submission and retain final versions.
* Maintain internal corrective action plans (CAPs) for known contract breaches, so completed fixes are documented before the client asks, and lead the response when the client invokes the contract's formal CAP process. Track audit findings, management responses, fixes, and closeout against contract timelines, and report recurring performance and quality themes to leadership.

**Key deliverables**
--------------------

* Proposal and client-response calendar, plus a project plan for each RFP, renewal, contract amendment, implementation, and major account change.
* Proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, and client-requested proposals.
* Standard content library, templates, style guide, and quality checklist.
* Commitment and negotiating-items log tying each commitment and redline decision to its approver and source.
* Audit request log, scope and ownership matrix, and evidence-package standards.
* Internal CAP register for known contract breaches, plus a findings, management-response, and corrective-action tracker and audit closeout packages.
* Leadership summaries of open proposals, implementation and change status, at-risk deliverables, and audit status.

***\*\*\*This is a remote role, but the ideal candidate will live in the Eastern Time Zone\*\*\****

**Minimum qualifications**

* 7+ years of work experience.
* Experience managing end-to-end proposal or RFP responses for complex healthcare or PBM clients.
* Experience planning, executing, and delivering across concurrent deadlines and owners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and proposal content-management tools.

**Preferred qualifications**

* PBM, health plan, or government program experience, including implementations or vendor transitions.
* Experience coordinating audits, regulatory requests, or evidence-based client reviews.
* Experience validating pricing, performance guarantee, or contract commitments in proposals.
* Proposal management or project management certification.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$67,900.00 - $182,549.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

role.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

**ABOUT ENOVIS™**

Enovis Corporation (NYSE: ENOV) is an innovation-driven medical technology growth company dedicated to developing clinically differentiated solutions that generate measurably better patient outcomes and transform workflows. Powered by a culture of continuous improvement, global talent and innovation, the Company’s extensive range of products, services and integrated technologies fuels active lifestyles in orthopedics and beyond. For more information about Enovis, please visit www.enovis.com.

**What You'll Do**

At Enovis™ we pay attention to the details. We embrace collaboration with our partners and patients, and take pride in the pursuit of scientific excellence — with the goal of transforming medical technology as we know it.

Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. Why work at Enovis? See for yourself.

As a key member of the Quality Assurance team, you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward through transforming patient care and creating better patient outcomes.

**Job Title**:

Sr Manager, Quality Assurance

**Reports To**:

Director, Quality Assurance

**Location:**

Fort Worth, TX

**Business Unit Description**:

QA

**Job Title/High-Level Position Summary:**

The Sr. Quality Assurance Manager is responsible for leading a team of quality engineers and Quality technicians in driving product and process excellence across the Recovery Sciences /Bracing and Support device portfolio. This role ensures compliance with regulatory standards, support manufacturing as well as new product introduction and fosters a culture of continuous improvement. The Sr. Quality Assurance Manager will collaborate cross-functionally to implement quality strategies that enhance product reliability, reduce risk, and improve operational efficiency across multiple locations.

**Key Responsibilities**:

 

* Lead and mentor a team of quality engineers and technicians, providing technical guidance and performance management.
* Develop and implement quality strategies that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Lead quality engineering support for manufacturing operations, ensuring robust process controls, effective risk management, and validation of production methods.
* Ensure compliance with FDA QSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, and ISO 14971 standards.
* Drive root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) for product and process issues.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, and Supply Chain to resolve quality challenges and improve processes.
* Support internal and external audits, acting as a subject matter expert for quality engineering practices.

* Maintain and improve quality system documentation, including procedures, work instructions, and validation protocols.
* Be qualified as a Laser safety officer for the DFW location.
* Represent the LiteCure, TJM, and TJD Quality Management System as Management Representative.

**Travel requirements:**

* 50% to Tijuana sites

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Biomedical, Industrial, or related field); Master’s degree preferred.
* 8+ years of experience in quality engineering within medical devices or other regulated industries, including 3+ years in a leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 13485, FDA QSR, ISO 14971.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex projects.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Desired Characteristics:**

* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Certified Quality Manager (CQM), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Familiarity with eQMS systems, statistical software, and metrology tools.
* Demonstrated success in driving quality improvements and regulatory compliance.

*Currently, Enovis does not provide sponsorship for employment visas (e.g., H-1B) and will not offer such sponsorship in the future. Applicants must already have full-time work authorization in the United States, both now and in the future, without requiring sponsorship.*

**“Creating better together”. It’s the Enovis purpose, and it’s what drives us and empowers us every day on a global scale.** We know that the power to create better – for our customers, our team members, and our shareholders – begins with having the best team, pursuing common goals, operating at the highest levels, and delivering extraordinary outcomes.

**What does creating better together mean to us at Enovis? Discover the “why” behind our purpose, values and behaviors:**

Our Enovis Purpose, Values and Behaviors on Vimeo

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Spending and Savings Accounts
* 401(k) Plan
* Vacation, Sick Leave, and Holidays
* Income Protection Plans
* Discounted Insurance Rates
* Legal Services

Join us in creating better together.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** 
Enovis provides equal employment opportunities based on merit, experience, and other work-related criteria without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, sex, age, pregnancy, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We also strive to provide reasonable accommodation to employees’ beliefs and practices that do not conflict with Enovis policies and applicable law. We value the unique contributions that every employee brings to their role with Enovis.

role.description:
The Director of Cyber Operational Excellence leads the design, deployment, and continuous improvement of a modern, digitally enabled Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity operating model.

This critical role will lead the improvement and governance of HBS’s OT cybersecurity capability and standards across the globe to ensure HBS has the ability to provide market-ready and competition leading solutions for customers.

You will report directly to our Chief Operating Officer and you'll work out of the Atlanta, GA location on a hybrid schedule.

 

**You Must Have**

* Minimum 8 years demonstrated experience in cybersecurity architecture or solution architecture for OT and IT systems.
* Competent with security frameworks and standards such as: ISO 27001, NIST Guidelines, IEC/ISA 62443, CIS.
* Strong understanding of service contracts, entitlement models, field operations, and planning systems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders in a complex, matrixed environment.
Experience leading a high‑impact team 

**Success Measures**

* Understands industry cybersecurity standards and has insights into in country cybersecurity regulations.
* Provides strategic input and guidance for global Buildings OT focused cybersecurity solutions.
* Provides cybersecurity technical knowledge and experience to help close high-level sales.
Orders and margin above set quota in support of Annual Operating Plan (AOP). 

*Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status.* Learn more

 

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and operationalize the end‑to‑end cybersecurity value chain, integrating cybersecurity offerings across new projects, service contract bundles, entitlement structures, digital capabilities, and customer use cases into a cohesive and scalable operating model.
* Lead the evolution of standardized, value‑optimized cybersecurity offerings, moving away from highly customized, labor‑biased delivery models.
* Partner cross‑functionally with Commercial, Digital, IT, Finance, and Operations leaders to align strategy, execution, and investment priorities.
* Establish closed‑loop Voice of the Customer (VOC) and Voice of the Employee (VOE) feedback mechanisms to continuously improve cybersecurity design and execution.
* Lead transformation initiatives across short‑, medium‑, and long‑term horizons, ensuring adoption of new operating models and ways of working.
* Directly manage and develop a high‑performing team focused on cybersecurity offering definition, management, analytics, and continuous improvement, including improving deployment policies.
* Monitor and analyze market trends including ability to differentiate against competitors’ services and products.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and customer focus within the team.

We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.
