role.title: Plant Manager
role.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Plant manager will provide leadership and direction to ensure the continual, efficient and uniform operation which will meet or exceed customer expectations in a safe and orderly manner.
 
He/she will develop and implement plans coordinated with the Corporate Business Plan to increase the reliability and continually improve the quality and efficiencies of the products and services provided by the business unit.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Supervise branch production using RMAS Warehouse Management System and available Production Planning tools
* Develop plans and procedures to insure the safety of all employees and visitors of the warehouse and Clarify and correct any incorrect warehouse procedures
* Ensure operations and equipment is in compliance to corporate guidelines and OSHA Standards
* Verify inventory and make adjustments where necessary
* Hire, train and motivate warehouse employees to build bench strength and increase retention by scheduling and provide training for growth and compliance
* Maintain equipment to provide maximum availability and minimum down time
* Evaluate and recommend new equipment purchases to enhance quality, capabilities and productivity
* Communicate and monitor progress towards company safety, returns and allowances, and on time shipment and delivery directives
* Responsible for building maintenance and security
* Monitor quality and process improvement throughout the warehouse using SAP reports
* Ensure that preventive and corrective action methods are followed to eliminate or correct procedures and practices which do not meet customer requirements
* Follow progressive disciplinary action to adhere to policy and procedures
* Ensure adequate support of the sales department and its customers in a timely and orderly manner
* Assist with customer problems, including on-site visits where necessary
* Facilitate Lean practices in the Plant
* Purchase or direct the purchase of necessary warehouse supplies to insure the ability to comply with written work instructions and customer requirements
* Attend regional and corporate meetings when required
* Perform employee reviews as required
* Assist in contract negotiations, where applicable
* This is a position that works directly on the warehouse floor on or around heavy machinery
* Meets TKMNA Employee Attributes/Competencies

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirement for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

**This position has been identified as** **“safety sensitive”** **by thyssenkrupp under applicable laws. Accordingly, any application for this position that is considered for employment with thyssenkrupp requires successful completion of pre-employment drug testing, which may include testing for marijuana in accordance with any applicable federal, state, and local laws.**

**Qualifications:**

Minimum Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree preferred (in a Business, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Behavioral Science curriculum)
* Two years direct Warehouse Supervision or team leadership, experience
* Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Office application, Excel, Word, Access and PowerPoint a must
* An understanding of Basic Lean Manufacturing Principles
* Safety Mindset

Preferred Requirements:

* MBA, Master’s degree or Ph.D. is a plus
* Exposure to labor relations, safety programs, ISO standards, Lean practices and sale functions.
* This individual must also possess good leadership qualities and the ability to build an effective team as well as be an effective team member

**Job Compensation**
--------------------

Up to $119K-$147K annually

**Benefits Overview**
---------------------

We offer competitive company benefits to eligible positions, such as:

* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
* Life Insurance and Disability
* Voluntary Wellness Programs
* 401(k) or RRSP programs with Company Match
* Paid Vacation and Holidays
* Tuition Reimbursement
* And more!

*Benefits may vary based on job, country, union role, and/or company segment.* *Please work with your recruiter or tk representative for applicable benefits information.*

role.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Senior Manager Quality Compliance**

**Working at Abbott** 
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists

**The Opportunity** 
This position works out of our Plymouth, MN location in the **Electrophysiology** division, we’re advancing the treatment of heart and vascular disease through breakthrough medical technologies, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

As the **Senior Manager Quality Compliance**, you’ll provide leadership for quality system compliance initiatives, audit readiness, regulatory change management, field actions, and quality compliance strategy across the EP business. This role leads teams and collaborates across functions to strengthen compliance capabilities, support inspections and audits, and drive continuous improvement

**What You’ll Work On**

* Lead quality compliance programs, including external audit support, inspection readiness activities, and quality system effectiveness initiatives.
* Develop and execute compliance strategies for the EP business, strengthening audit capability across sites and functions.
* Manage and support Health Hazard Evaluation (HHE), RRE/SRE, field action, and remediation activities to ensure timely and compliant execution.
* Assess industry trends, regulatory changes, and standards updates, implementing solutions that advance organizational compliance.
* Lead and mentor team members while partnering with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve compliance objectives.

Quality Management Systems/Compliance

* Support life cycle of external audits (ie. execution, preparation, completion, etc).
* Drive site audit readiness for FDA & NB
* Expand compliance capabilities to support IA
* Support Certificate Management and Finance Portfolio Management
* Manage HHE and Field Action Program
* Impact Analysis on Industry Trends
* Manage Field Action Strategy, as appropriate
* As needed, support regulation and standards change assessment

People Management & Strategy

* Lead diverse team to achieve compliance goals
* Develop compliance strategy for EP BU
* Develop audit capability across EP sites and functions
* Demonstrate Compliance Expertise through Leadership Behaviors

Lead Strategic Quality & Compliance Programs

* Develop and execute global quality and compliance strategies that align with divisional priorities and long-term business objectives.
* Build and manage program roadmaps, business cases, budgets, funding requests, and implementation plans for complex, multi-workstream initiatives.
* Establish meaningful partnerships across Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Commercial organizations to drive successful program execution.
* Present program strategies, progress updates, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

Strengthen Audit Readiness & Inspection Success

* Lead and support the lifecycle of external audits, including preparation, execution, response management, and follow-up activities.
* Drive ongoing inspection readiness across global sites, including preparedness for FDA, Notified Body, and other regulatory inspections.
* Partner with site and functional leaders to identify compliance gaps, implement remediation plans, and sustain inspection readiness programs.

Advance the Global Quality Management System

* Ensure effective implementation and governance of quality programs within the division's Quality Management System.
* Assess and manage impacts of evolving global regulations, standards, and industry expectations.
* Own and coordinate standards and regulation change management activities, including impact assessments and implementation plans.
* Support certificate management activities and external certification requirements.

Lead Compliance Improvement & Risk Reduction Efforts

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance compliance effectiveness, operational efficiency, and quality performance.
* Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, analytics, AI-enabled solutions, training programs, and process improvements.
* Monitor quality metrics, program effectiveness, and compliance trends to proactively mitigate risk.
* Manage and communicate program dashboards and executive-level reporting.

Support Critical Quality Events & Field Actions

* Provide leadership and support for field action strategies and implementation activities when required.
* Support Health Hazard Evaluation (HHE), Risk Review Evaluation (RRE), and Software Risk Evaluation (SRE) programs to ensure timely completion and compliance.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to effectively manage quality records, communications, and closure activities.

Develop a Culture of Quality

* Mentor and advise colleagues across the organization on compliant decision-making and quality best practices.
* Enhance organizational compliance capabilities through training, consultation, and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor industry trends and emerging compliance risks to help shape future quality strategies and organizational readiness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Industrial Technology, or a related field.
* 13+ years of combined experience in Quality, Compliance, Manufacturing Operations, Regulatory Affairs, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, cross-functional programs in a regulated industry.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and compliance processes.
* Previous management experience.
* Experience influencing stakeholders and driving results in a matrixed global organization.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-facing leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Medical device, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industry experience.
* Experience supporting FDA inspections, Notified Body audits, MDSAP, ISO standards, or related regulatory environments.
* International experience and/or foreign language proficiency.
* Experience with audit readiness programs, field actions, regulatory change management, and quality system governance.
* Strong analytical and business acumen with the ability to connect compliance requirements to operational and business outcomes

role.title: Sourcing Director: NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers
role.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

The Director, NPI Execution, M&A Integration & Supplier Transfers leads strategic execution across new product introduction, acquired-business integration, and supplier/manufacturing transfer initiatives. This senior leader is accountable for ensuring products, processes, supply chains, and teams transition successfully from development, acquisition, or incumbent suppliers into stable, compliant, scalable operations. 
The role requires strong business judgment, deep supply-base knowledge, technical fluency, and the ability to lead complex programs in a regulated medical-device environment. The Director partners closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, R&D, Finance, Manufacturing Engineering, and leadership to deliver continuity of supply, cost competitiveness, product quality, and growth objectives. 
 
Reports to: Senior Director Procurement (Cost Center - M&A) 
Direct reports: Integration Program leaders, supplier-transfer leaders, NPI project managers, supplier development personnel

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

1. NPI Execution and Operational Readiness 

* Lead the end-to-end operational execution of New Product Introduction programs, from design-transfer planning through commercialization and sustained production.
* Establish integrated NPI execution plans & Ensure alignment between product development timelines and operational deliverables, including design transfer, process characterization, validation, supplier readiness, and product availability.
* Drive structured phase-gate governance with external suppliers , program reviews, escalation mechanisms, and executive decision-making for high-priority launches.

 
2. M&A Operations Integration 

* Serve as the Procurement lead for M&A integrations.
* Executes the integration for acquired companies for mitigation of supply-chain risk, supplier dependencies, tier-II management, partners with SQ team for quality-system maturity.
* Define and lead integration roadmaps for acquired businesses, including supplier onboarding, quality-system alignment, tier-II management and smooth transition to Contract manufacturing partner(s)
* Lead Procurement part of integration governance, ensuring milestones, decisions, risks, and accountabilities are visible and managed at the appropriate leadership level.

 
3. Supplier Transfer and Supply-Base Optimization 

* Lead complex supplier-transfer programs, including strategic sourcing transitions, supplier exits, dual-source strategies, vertical-integration initiatives, and manufacturing footprint changes.
* Develop transfer strategies that balance continuity of supply, quality, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, cost, capacity, and timing.
* Ensure supplier transfers are executed in accordance with applicable quality-system requirements, change-control processes, validation requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Direct supplier selection, qualification, technical transfer, process validation, first-article activities, production ramp-up, and supplier performance monitoring.

 
4. People Leadership and Organizational Capability 

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of program, technical, supply-chain, and supplier-management professionals.
* Set clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for direct reports.
* Build succession capability and strengthen organizational depth in NPI execution, technical operations, supplier transfer, and integration management.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration among teams with potentially competing objectives, timelines, and priorities.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

Leadership 

* Builds high-performing teams and develops future leaders.
* Establishes clarity, accountability, and disciplined execution
* Leads through ambiguity, organizational change, and competing business priorities.

Business Acumen 

* Connects technical and operational decisions to financial, customer, and enterprise outcomes.
* Evaluates strategic tradeoffs with an enterprise-wide perspective.
* Identifies opportunities for value creation, risk reduction, and sustainable growth.

Technical and Procurement Expertise 

* Understands manufacturing processes, product industrialization, supplier capabilities, process controls, validation, and quality-system expectations.
* Demonstrates strong command of supply-base dynamics, supplier economics, sourcing strategy, and operational risk.
* Can challenge technical assumptions constructively and facilitate fact-based decisions.

Program Execution 

* Drives complex initiatives from strategy through implementation and stabilization.
* Uses effective governance, metrics, risk management, and escalation practices.
* Maintains focus on customer service, quality, compliance, delivery, and financial results.

Influence and Collaboration 

* Builds credibility with senior leaders, technical experts, plant leadership, suppliers, and all other stakeholders.
* Resolves conflict constructively and aligns diverse stakeholders behind common objectives.
* Communicates complex issues in a concise, actionable manner.

**Your Background**
-------------------

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, or a related technical discipline.
* Approximately 20 years of progressive experience in medical devices, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, or another highly regulated industry.
* Hands on experience & leadership experience in one or more of the following areas:
* New Product Introduction and product industrialization
* Strategic Sourcing and Supplier Management
* Supplier Transfers or Manufacturing Transfers
* Mergers, Acquisitions, and Business Integration
* Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations Program Management
* Proven people-management experience, including leading managers and technical professionals in a matrixed global environment.
* Strong knowledge of supplier qualification, supplier development, capacity planning, quality agreements, process validation, and manufacturing transfer principles.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate and manage supply-base risk, including sole-source exposure, capacity constraints, supplier quality issues, and business-continuity risks.
* Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, cost analysis, budget ownership, and value-capture management.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting medical-device product launches and design-transfer activities.
* Experience integrating acquired companies, product portfolios, manufacturing sites, or supplier networks.
* Familiarity with regulated quality systems and supplier-control expectations.
* Experience with lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, operational excellence, or structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Experience leading global suppliers and geographically distributed teams.
* Professional certifications in program management, supply chain, quality, or lean methodologies are desirable.

**Expected Compensation Data**
------------------------------

role.title: Director, Operational Excellence and Innovation
role.description:
**Job Overview**

Citadel Credit Union is seeking a visionary leader to serve as Director of Operational Excellence & Innovation. This role will drive process improvement within the Experience & Retail team and will focus on enhancing current business processes within the team. This position will also focus on integrating new technologies within the organization, such as blockchain (DLT), smart contracts, and artificial intelligence into member and employee experience to drive efficiency, automation and service improvements. The Director will lead, collaborate, and influence the business to modernize workflows, automate processes, and position Citadel as a technology leader in retail financial services.

**What will I be doing?**

As a Director of Operational Excellence & Innovation, you will support Citadel’s Experience and Retail environments in meeting strategic initiatives for our members. The following tasks must be executed with high fidelity:

* Lead the design and implementation of emerging technologies to include blockchain and AI-powered automation solutions for retail operations.
* Act as liaison and collaborate with various lines of business, including EPMO, Digital & Transformation, and Retail Operations & Support.
* Coordinating of testing and implementing branch technology and compliance.
* Act as liaison between the team and internal/external partners to ensure successful deployment of system upgrades and enhancements.
* Manage team related vendor relationships.
* Oversee the development and deployment of smart contracts to automate efficiencies in member onboarding, KYC/AML/NRA compliance, transaction processing, and reporting.
* Identify, assess, and recommend blockchain platforms, smart contract frameworks, and AI vendors to support retail automation initiatives.
* Collaborates on system and workflow enhancements while acting as a vendor and system liaison.
* Manage pilot programs for new automation solutions, collect feedback, refine processes, and oversee full-scale deployment and staff training across team channels.
* Ensure all solutions meet regulatory requirements, maintain data immutability, and enhance fraud prevention through biometric and cryptographic security.
* Monitor system performance, optimize retail workflows, and implement enhancements based on analytics and stakeholder input.
* Develop and execute strategies to overcome resistance to technology adoption, including comprehensive staff training and phased implementation.

**What we are looking for?**

* 7+ years’ experience in process improvement, project management, or technology implementation in retail financial services.
* Bachelor's degree; MBA or advanced degree a plus
* Proven expertise in blockchain/DLT, smart contracts, and AI workflow automation.
* Strong understanding of KYC/AML/NRA compliance and regulatory reporting in retail banking.
* Experience with vendor selection and management for enterprise technology solutions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to analyze complex retail workflows and drive cross-functional collaboration.
* Familiarity with zero-trust architecture and Microsoft Azure AD integration.
* Experience with RPA tools and business process automation platforms.
* Knowledge of UTAUT, TPB, and TAM models for user technology adoption.
* Prior experience in retail financial technology innovation or credit union operations.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

role.description:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

Role summary: The (USA) Director, Operations leads the execution of complex projects and programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives through strategic planning, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration. This role directs operational initiatives to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and drive business growth while managing budgets and performance standards. The Director fosters strong partnerships across teams to implement innovative solutions and continuous improvements. By leveraging analytical insights and operational expertise, this position supports decision-making processes and promotes a culture of accountability, integrity, and excellence to achieve sustainable organizational success. About the team: The team drives the transformation of Walmart’s fulfillment capabilities to enhance the customer experience through strategic program management and data-driven decision-making. It leads initiatives across speed, assortment, pricing, and recovery by collaborating with Product, Pricing, Walmart+, Merchandising, Network, Operations, Analytics, and Finance teams. Focused on identifying challenges, designing tests, and scaling solutions, the team ensures alignment with Walmart’s goals through effective stakeholder engagement, financial oversight, and business operations. This collaborative environment emphasizes innovation and operational excellence to deliver impactful, scalable results.

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

**What you'll do:**
 

* Oversee execution of complex projects and programs, managing timelines, budgets, and performance standards to ensure successful implementation.
* Analyze data and business trends to develop actionable recommendations aligned with organizational objectives.
* Lead cross-functional teams to design and implement process improvements that enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with key stakeholders to support business initiatives and drive execution.
* Develop and monitor scorecards and tracking mechanisms to measure outcomes and adjust strategies accordingly.
* Foster talent development through coaching, mentoring, and succession planning to maintain a skilled workforce.
* Promote adherence to company standards of integrity, ethics, and compliance across teams.

 
**What you'll bring:**
 

* Extensive experience in operations management and leading large-scale complex projects with proven ability to manage timelines, budgets, and performance metrics.
* Strong proficiency in business strategy development, data analysis, and translating insights into actionable recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
* Demonstrated success in cross-functional team leadership, fostering collaboration to drive process improvements and operational efficiency.
* Expertise in developing and implementing innovative solutions to reduce costs and enhance business outcomes.
* Proven capability in talent development, mentoring, and succession planning to build and sustain high-performing teams.
* Commitment to integrity, ethical leadership, and promoting a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

role.title: Senior Director, Operational Excellence Manager
role.description:
What We Need
 
Corpay is currently looking to hire a Senior Director, Operational Excellence Manager, within our Corpay Payables organization. In the role as a player coach, you will manage a team of operational excellence professionals and lead enterprise-wide initiatives that simplify operations, improve customer experience, accelerate business growth, and unlock the value of automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI). You will combine deep operational excellence expertise with a passion for digital transformation, Lean Six Sigma methodologies, AI-enabled process optimization, and organizational change. This individual thrives in ambiguity, influences across organizational boundaries, and delivers sustainable improvements that drive revenue, reduce costs, improve speed to market, and elevate performance. You will report to the VP, Operational Excellence and regularly collaborate with Operations, Product Management, Technology, Finance, Sales, and Customer Success to identify opportunities, challenge existing processes, and deliver innovative solutions that create measurable business value.
 
 
How We Work
 
As a Senior Director, Operational Excellence & AI Transformation, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
 

* Company-issued equipment + remote access
* Formal, hands-on training

Role Responsibilities
 
 
**The responsibilities of the role will include:** 
Enterprise Transformation
 
Lead strategic operational transformation initiatives across multiple business functions.
 
Partner with executive leadership to identify opportunities that improve revenue, reduce costs, improve customer experience, and increase operational scalability.
 
Serve as an internal consultant, providing recommendations supported by data, financial analysis, and business cases.
 
 
Process Excellence
 
Conduct discovery workshops, value stream mapping, and current-state assessments.
 
Lead Lean Six Sigma initiatives focused on eliminating waste, improving quality, and reducing operational complexity.
 
Establish future-state operating models that enable sustainable growth.
 
 
Artificial Intelligence & Automation
 
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, intelligent automation, workflow technologies, and digital capabilities to improve operational performance.
 
Develop business cases supporting AI investments, including expected ROI and productivity improvements.
 
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend scalable solutions.
 
Champion responsible AI adoption and establish best practices across operational teams.
 
 
Operational Readiness & Change Management
 
Lead operational readiness planning for strategic initiatives.
 
Develop implementation strategies, communications, training plans, and adoption metrics.
 
Partner with business leaders to ensure successful deployment and long-term sustainability.
 
 
Analytics & Business Performance
 
Establish baseline metrics and define measurable success criteria.
 
Design executive dashboards and KPI reporting.
 
Analyze operational trends and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
 
Measure post-implementation results to validate business outcomes.
 
 
Cross-Functional Leadership
 
Influence senior leaders without direct authority.
 
Facilitate executive workshops and strategic planning sessions.
 
Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Customer Success, and Sales.
 
 
Qualifications & Skills
 

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification (required).
* 12+ years of experience leading enterprise operational excellence, business transformation, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience applying Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, or intelligent automation to improve operational performance, enhance productivity, and deliver measurable business outcomes is required.
* Experience with enterprise AI platforms (e.g., ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce, or similar) and the ability to identify and implement AI use cases within business operations strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading large cross-functional initiatives from strategy through implementation.
* Experience delivering measurable business outcomes including cost reduction, revenue acceleration, productivity improvements, or customer experience enhancements.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Experience building business cases supported by financial analysis and operational metrics.

Artificial Intelligence & Digital Skills
 
 
**Required experience with one or more of the following:** 

* Generative AI (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce, Gemini, Claude, etc.)
* AI-assisted business process redesign
* Intelligent workflow automation
* AI productivity tools
* AI prompt engineering
* Digital transformation initiatives

**Preferred experience:** 

* Process mining
* Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
* Workflow automation platforms
* Salesforce ecosystem
* Business Intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications
 

* PMP certification
* Master's degree (MBA or related field)
* Experience in Financial Services, Payments, SaaS, or FinTech
* Knowledge of Operational Readiness methodologies
* Experience with customer experience transformation initiatives

Benefits & Perks
 

* Medical, Dental & Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire
* Automatic enrollment into our 401k plan (subject to eligibility requirements)
* Virtual fitness classes offered company-wide
* Robust PTO including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, and volunteer time
* Employee discounts with major providers (wireless, gym, car rental, etc.)
* Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations
* Fun culture with the company

About Corpay
 
 
Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.
 
At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.
 
As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.
 
**Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:** Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions.
 
**Learn more about Corpay:** https://www.corpay.com
 
 
Transparency & Compliance
 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer
 
Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. role.title: Vice President of Operations
role.description:
At Emmi Roth, we’re passionate about creating exceptional cheeses. As a leader in the specialty cheese industry, we blend traditional craftsmanship with innovation. Our commitment to local sourcing and quality makes us a trusted brand in the food industry.

Joining Emmi Roth means becoming part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and a shared dedication to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work with some of the finest cheeses in the world while contributing to a company that prides itself on both heritage and progress. If you're passionate about food, craftsmanship, and making an impact, we’d love for you to be a part of our journey!

**Summary** 
The Vice President of Operations serves as a core member of Emmi Roth’s Executive Leadership Team, shaping and advancing the enterprise’s operational agenda across all manufacturing sites. This role defines the long-term Operations vision, aligns enterprise strategy with operational priorities, and ensures sustained, world-class performance across safety, quality, service, cost, and sustainability.

Operating with full executive authority within established governance frameworks, the Vice President of Operations partners closely with the VP of Supply Chain to jointly steward end-to-end value chain outcomes, balancing performance, resilience, and growth.

**Duties and Responsibilities** 
**Executive Accountability & Scope** 

* Enterprise-wide accountability for operational outcomes across all manufacturing facilities, including safety, quality, service, productivity, cost, and ESG outcomes
* Strategic leadership of the Operations function, establishing strategic direction, enterprise priorities, and performance frameworks that enable long-term success
* Oversight of manufacturing, production, employee safety, food safety, maintenance, engineering, R& D and operational excellence capabilities, with full decision authority across these domains
* Ownership of the Operations P&L, including financial performance, capital allocation, and long-range investment strategy, with authority to direct resources within approved plans
* Definition and advancement of a multi-year Operations strategy aligned with Emmi Roth and Emmi Group objectives
* Enterprise accountability for compliance, risk management, and governance across food safety, quality, regulatory, environmental, and employee safety standards
* Strategic partnership with the VP of Supply Chain to co-own value chain performance, aligning trade-offs and outcomes across service, cost, inventory, and supply continuity
* Leadership of organizational capability, including leadership and development, succession planning, and leadership pipeline development within Operations

role.title: VP of Commercial Operations
role.description:
About Us:

Flow Control Group (FCG) is a leading provider of fluid handling, process, and industrial automation solutions across North America. We are a 100% employee-owned organization made up of over 3,000 team members and 115+ entrepreneurial brands, each empowered to think big, move fast, and bring innovative ideas to life.

At FCG, we believe in the power of partnership and entrepreneurship. We work collaboratively across our brands to drive growth, unlock new opportunities, and deliver real impact for our customers, combining local expertise with national strength.

Visit our Website: flowcontrolgroup.com

Job Description:

**Position Overview**

The Vice President of Commercial Operations is a critical enterprise leadership role responsible for driving revenue growth, commercial discipline, and operational excellence across a decentralized network of industrial distribution brands. This leader serves as the connective tissue between the corporate commercial strategy and the front-line selling organizations, translating strategy into execution across 10 Technology Groups (TGs) without disrupting the entrepreneurial culture that makes each brand within the TGs successful.

This is not a role for someone who manages from a dashboard. The right leader spends time in the field, builds relationships with technology groups, commercial leaders, brand leaders, and sellers, and earns the trust of decentralized operators by demonstrating commercial credibility. At the same time, they must be able to proficiently articulate a clear, data-driven commercial narrative to executive leadership.

The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution and reports directly to the EVP, Commercial Operations. This position owns the commercial operating system (Salesforce) and metrics architecture (pipeline, bookings, win rates). The position will work closely with teams focused on pricing, cross-selling leadership, and strategic/national account programs while enabling each brand to run its own P&L with autonomy.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

1. Commercial Strategy & Revenue Growth

* Partner with brand, commercial, and technology group leaders to set growth targets, identify whitespace opportunities, and build actionable territory plans.
* Support cross-selling initiatives by jointly developing tools, incentives, training, and coordination structures that enable multi-brand selling without disrupting brand autonomy.
* Build and maintain the commercial calendar, including QBRs, pipeline reviews, seller performance reviews, and board-level commercial updates.
* Work directly with brands to define and implement actions to pursue new and emerging markets and customers.

2. Salesforce CRM Ownership & Commercial Operations

* Own the Salesforce platform(s) as the commercial operating system, focusing on adoption, data quality, pipeline integrity, and continuous improvement.
* Drive Salesforce adoption across 100+ brands, from onboarding through advanced usage. Build a culture where sellers see CRM as a tool that helps them win, not a reporting burden.
* Work with the Commercial Operations team to design and maintain the pipeline architecture, including stage definitions and opportunity hygiene standards that support forecasting methodology.
* Build and deliver the commercial reporting suite for field and management teams, including weekly pipeline reports, monthly bookings dashboards, quarterly board presentations, and ad hoc analytics for leadership.
* Partner with IT and Salesforce administrators to evaluate, implement, and optimize new capabilities, such as CPQ integration, seller mapping, Marketing Cloud integration, and AI-assisted selling tools.
* Ensure data integrity and consistency across brands by establishing and maintaining standardized account hierarchies, contact management, and activity logging to support cross-brand visibility.

3. Seller Performance & Enablement

* Build and manage the seller performance framework. Develop and implement common practices for quota setting, attainment tracking, performance tiering, and accountability structures across a decentralized organization.
* Partner with HR and brand leadership to identify, develop, and retain top commercial talent. This includes succession planning for key sales leadership roles and building a pipeline of future sellers and sales leaders.
* Design and deploy seller enablement programs. Work closely with Learning and Development on product training, competitive positioning, value-based consultative sales methodology, and Salesforce proficiency.
* Establish a coaching culture through field ride-alongs, joint customer calls, and quarterly seller reviews that combine data with direct observation.
* Build and track leading indicators of seller health, including activity levels, pipeline creation rates, win rates by category, and new logo acquisition trends.
* Identify and develop a President's Club structure. Establish the KPIs required for qualification, administration, and ongoing management. Through this program, work closely with the field to build a world-class sales organization.

4. Management Reporting

* Prepare and present commercial updates to the FCG Leadership Team and private equity commercial sponsors, including monthly commercial operating reviews and market context.
* Develop and maintain the commercial KPI framework and utilize metrics that provide an accurate picture of business performance, including early-warning bookings indicators that surface issues before they become problems.
* Partner with the CFO, Operations, and Finance teams to align commercial forecasting with financial projections. Ensure the commercial pipeline translates accurately into revenue and margin guidance.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* 15+ years of progressive commercial leadership and direct sales experience, with at least 5 years in a VP or Director-level role with broad commercial scope.
* Experience operating within a decentralized, multi-brand, or multi-location industrial distribution, manufacturing, or services organization. Must have the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Deep Salesforce proficiency, not only as a user but as a platform owner. Extensive experience driving adoption, building reporting architecture that meets field needs, and managing CRM as a commercial operating system across a complex organization.
* Demonstrated track record of building and scaling commercial operations infrastructure from the ground up. Proven sales management success leading commercial teams that have successfully built pipeline frameworks, seller performance systems, and cross-selling capabilities.
* Strong financial acumen and the ability to construct a revenue bridge from pipeline generation (coverage models/bowling charts), model pricing and volume impacts from system KPIs, and communicate credibly with FCG leadership.
* Experience presenting to private equity sponsors or public company boards. Systems and processes built must be capable of supporting publicly traded company performance standards within 3–5 years.
* Industrial distribution, specialty distribution, or industrial services background strongly preferred. Clear and demonstrated understanding of buying motions, customer types, and channel dynamics of MRO and project-based industrial selling.
* Ability to leverage data to identify and build a team of sellers capable of progressing from Level 1 to Level 4 management structures, demonstrating proficiency in sales engagement processes, and partnering with the Strategic Accounts team to secure multi-site, large, complex deals.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in a private equity-backed platform business, including an understanding of value creation plans, EBITDA management, and the commercial levers that drive enterprise value.
* Strategic accounts or national accounts leadership experience.
* Cross-selling or integrated solutions selling experience in a multi-brand or multi-product environment.
* Familiarity with industrial end markets, including:

 + Energy
 + Power generation
 + Aerospace
 + EPC / Construction
 + Food & Beverage
 + Water / Wastewater
 + Automotive
 + Industrial manufacturing
 + Pulp & Paper
 + Data centers
* Experience with eCommerce in an industrial or B2B context, including the ability to promote and integrate eCommerce into sellers' daily workflows to maximize sales opportunities.
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree in business, engineering, or a related field.

role.description:
Description:

### **JOB SUMMARY:**

The General Manager reports directly to the President and leads the Watertown, Connecticut location. This role translates company strategy into daily execution and is accountable for site performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, employee engagement, and customer satisfaction.

As a member of the Leadership Team, the General Manager establishes operational controls, reporting systems, and performance expectations to improve profitability, workforce development, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term business sustainability. The role collaborates with Sales, Finance, Engineering, Human Resources, Quality, and Operations across locations.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

#### **Operational Leadership & Strategy:**

* Lead daily site operations and align departmental priorities, resources, and execution with company strategy.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and monitor performance indicators for safety, quality, on-time delivery, labor efficiency, inventory accuracy, first-pass yield, productivity, and profitability.
* Use operational reports and dashboards to identify performance gaps, assign corrective actions, and monitor results.

#### **Process & Financial Performance:**

* Manage site operational budgeting, labor planning, cost controls, and financial performance in collaboration with Finance and within approved authority.
* Lead initiatives to reduce waste, improve workflow, standardize processes, and apply lean manufacturing principles.
* Coordinate production priorities and resource planning across departments and locations to support customer commitments.
* Evaluate and implement approved technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate to improve efficiency and reduce non-value-added work.

#### **Safety, Quality & Customer Collaboration:**

* Manage and continuously improve the site safety program in coordination with designated company resources; ensure adherence to applicable company policies and safety and environmental requirements.
* Ensure site adherence to applicable quality management systems and ISO requirements; support audits, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Quality, and customer-facing teams to address customer needs, delivery commitments, product quality, and issue resolution.

#### **Leadership & Talent Development:**

* Lead and mentor department managers and operational leaders to improve accountability, consistency, and professional development.
* Develop succession plans and leadership development initiatives to strengthen organizational depth and business continuity.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee

Requirements:

### **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide site-level leadership and oversight of department managers and operational leaders within the assigned reporting structure.
* Establish performance expectations, provide regular feedback, and assess development needs in coordination with Human Resources and company leadership.

### **QUALIFICATIONS:**

#### **Required Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong business acumen and understanding of manufacturing operations, finance, quality systems, supply chain, customer service, sales support, and workforce management.
* Ability to lead operational change, build trust, and develop accountability and employee engagement across organizational levels.
* Proficiency in manufacturing metrics, operational reporting, financial analysis, and cost controls.
* Experience implementing process improvements, lean manufacturing initiatives, and operational standardization.
* Ability to use ERP/MRP systems, reporting tools, and other business systems to improve operational effectiveness.

#### **Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field preferred, but not required.
* At least eight years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, printing, converting, industrial production, or a related operational environment.
* Demonstrated success leading teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with responsibility for operational performance and measurable business results.
* Experience with custom manufacturing, technical products, labels, graphic overlays, membrane switches, or related industries preferred.
* Experience managing within ISO-certified or regulated manufacturing environments preferred.

### **LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information internally and externally across organizational levels.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills strongly preferred to support employee engagement, training, and operational communication.

### **MATHEMATICAL & ANALYTICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to interpret budgets, labor and production data, costs, inventory reports, and operational performance trends.
* Ability to use data to evaluate priorities, identify causes of performance gaps, and assess improvement results.

### **REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to think and act strategically and tactically, manage competing priorities, and make sound operational decisions.
* Ability to analyze problems, evaluate alternatives, and coordinate practical solutions across departments.

### **WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* Work is performed in office and manufacturing settings, with exposure to moving production equipment when entering production areas.
* Follow applicable site safety procedures and use required personal protective equipment in designated areas.
* Travel to customers, vendors, and JN White corporate as needed.

**Position Type and Compensation** 
This is a full-time, salaried, exempt position based in Watertown, Connecticut. The annual base salary range is $120,000–$150,000. Compensation within this range will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, skills, and internal equity.

**Benefits** 
JN White offers medical, dental, and vision insurance, with premium costs shared between the employee and employer. A variety of ancillary insurance benefits are also available; employee contributions and employer contributions, where applicable, vary by coverage elected.

Additional benefits include paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, a 401(k) retirement plan, and profit sharing. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements, waiting periods, company policies, and governing plan documents. Profit sharing is subject to plan terms and is not guaranteed.

**Equal Employment Opportunity** 
JN White is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, age, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Reasonable Accommodations** 
JN White provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees as required by applicable law. Applicants who need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process may contact Human Resources.

**Employment Disclaimer** 
This posting describes the general nature of the position and does not constitute an offer of employment or an employment contract. Employment with JN White is at will, subject to applicable law. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs.

role.description:
At Revlon, we create beauty innovations for everyone that inspire confidence and ignite joy every day.

Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company's DNA. Since its game-changing launch of the first opaque nail enamel in 1932 (and later, the first long-wear foundation), Revlon has provided consumers with high-quality product innovation, performance, and sophisticated glamour. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand.

Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world's most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more.

We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers.

We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty.

**This role is an Onsite Role:** This role requires full-time presence at our Oxford, NC office.

**Overview:**

* Responsible for the safe and efficient operation of the Oxford Filling and Assembly operation – may include multiple cost centers (or all). Specific responsibilities include Ensuring that the workplace is safe, and employees work in a safe manner; Provide that all GMP requirements and regulations are complied with; Ensuring that all people issues and developmental needs are met; monitoring production requirements such that all customer needs are met on a timely basis; Responsible for all financial results of the operation.
* Act as a backup to the Vice President of Manufacturing (as needed) and the Oxford site General Manager (as needed). Be aware of any major issues/action underway in other cost centers / production areas in order to fill in as needed.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Safety:** Ensure that a safe workplace is maintained at all times. Provide resources necessary to be proactive towards addressing issues in the workplace. Comply with all OSHA & Revlon guidelines and procedures. Assist Safety Director as needed with task forces, projects and teams. Measures: Safety incident rate; OSHA & Workmen's comp rates; Revlon Safety Index.
* **People:** Strive to make the Oxford site a great place to work by: proactively developing people (cross training, class work and challenges); Addressing all issues, concerns and disciplinary actions promptly and effectively; contributing to site efforts to address issues and concerns. Measures: GPTW survey results; Developmental activity; providing challenges & changes to drive the organization forward.
* **GMP / Regulatory:** Ensure that all Revlon & Governmental Good Manufacturing Practices are complied with. Provide resources necessary to address any issues before the operation is adversely affected. Work with the site Quality Director (and others – as needed) to implement any new requirements due to new products or new regulations. Provide / facilitate training as needed. Ensure that all appropriate records are accurate and maintained within guidelines. Measures: First pass yields, rejection rates (domestic and international); GMP audit scores.
* **Customer Service:** Ensure that all Customer requirements (domestic, international & special markets) are met per company objectives (Regular business forecast & Promotional commitments). Evaluate production needs on a forward basis to ensure that needed equipment and people resources are available to meet the customer's needs. Measures: Schedule adherence; % Dollars shipped vs. ordered (CSL); performance to promotional ship on time commitments.
* **Financial:** Responsible for all financial aspects of the Filling and Assembly operation: Control of Labor – Direct (productive effort); Indirect (support effort); Nonstandard (Rework & First pass yield issues); Material – performance to established standards & minimization of waste; Overhead – effective utilization of management staff, supplies and ancillary equipment; Capital – effective, proactive utilization of installed equipment base, addressing capacity and new product needs with adequate lead time to meet customer's needs. Support and facilitate site cost reduction objectives. Measures: Labor – Direct efficiency, indirect % to earned, nonstandard % to earned; Material – MUV; Overhead – performance to budget & tasks.
* + Overhead – Supplies, executive staff, support labor – Up to $14 Million annually
 + Material – Value of material moved through the filling and assembly operation - $250 Million annually
 + Labor – Direct Labor managed in the filling and assembly operation - $30 Million annually

**Responsible for establishing processes to:**

* Ensure that all employees in the operation have defined job duties and expectations and are managed according to those duties – and that timely corrective action takes place when needed.
* Ensure that reasonable schedules are formulated, meeting customer's needs and equipment capability. Interface with appropriate departments as needed to affect change.
* Ensure that all equipment is operational and performs within expected tolerances.
* Ensure that all Revlon and governmental policies, guidelines, rules and procedures are followed and adhered to.
* Interface with all other sites functional areas as needed (HR, Quality, Distribution, Finance, etc.)

**Qualifications:**

role.title: Senior Manager, Test Operations
role.description:
Application close date:
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed. 
 At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!    
 
 
This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities. 
 
 We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety and operational excellence. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable space flight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin’s vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.
 The Sr. Manager, Test Operations role is responsible for leading the GEEx engine test stand near Van Horn, Texas. The Sr. Manager is a leader of passionate team of engineers and technicians who perform testing on our LH2 and LOX engine. The Sr. Manager works closely with all Blue Origin business units developing tests to develop and qualify in-space fluid and engine systems. The Sr Manager integrates with Test Operations senior leaders and support organizations to plan, prepare, and conduct test operations on a multi-cell test stand safely and efficiently. The Sr. Manager is responsible for effectively planning and leading all aspects of capital, overhead and labor budgets, and managing capital improvement projects. Effective communications and long term planning are vital to a successful Sr. Manager.
 We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!
 Management Responsibilities: 
 Lead the team at the Giant Engine Experiment (GEEx) test stand to include recruiting, training, coaching, mentoring, developing, and retaining talent by following and developing performance management processes.
 Promote teamwork, employee engagement, and good employee morale.
 Be an exemplar of Blue Leadership Principles, focusing on demonstrating operational excellence.
 Maintain employee training and development records.
 Demonstrate high standards in test operations and work cooperatively with a team of Responsible Engineers, Test Ops counterparts from other test stands, maintenance, Quality Specialists, and other team members to ensure requirements are met.
 Assist in the preparation of regular programmatic reports to help communicate inwards and outwards across the organization.
 Prepare quantitative strategic plans to ensure the targets are met, and leverage team skills and capabilities to implement and supervise progress against the plans.
 Lead capital, overhead, and labor budget planning and execution.
 Engineering Responsibilities: 
 Establish the technical direction for the GEEx test engineering team.
 Develop and implement test plans and procedures; perform subsequent data reduction and reviews.
 Lead the team in the design, planning, fabrication, installation, and operation of test facilities to the unique requirements from business unit customers
 Lead daily test operations, , direct technician work and coordinate with internal customers
 Understand and solve issues in fluid and instrumentation systems.
 Perform root cause analysis and failure investigations, lead implementation of corrective actions or continuous improvement projects
 Perform process hazard analyses (PHA)..
 Perform schedule and cost estimation and management.
 Find opportunities for safety improvements and cost savings.
 Align with and improve processes for test stand configuration management.
 Qualifications: 
 BS degree in engineering or related field
 3+ years as a manager or lead of a technical team
 12+ years in an operations environment in large industry, petrochemical, or aerospace facilities
 Strong background in fluid dynamics and thermodynamics
 Strong project management, and team leadership
 Outstanding technical and non-technical writing and verbal skills
 Demonstrated leadership in establishing a high performing safety culture
 Demonstrated habitual drive to correct errors at their root and not pass them downstream
 Demonstrated experience in setting high standards of performance and holding teams accountable
 Demonstrated effectiveness in implementing continuous improvement to improve processes, methods and practices
 Demonstrated effectiveness in conflict-resolution and an ability to bring a group to a decision
 Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum
 Desired: 
 Demonstrated technical expertise in cryogenic test design and operations.
 Demonstrated technical expertise in liquid rocket engine test stand design, operation, and maintenance
 Previous experience operating in Process Safety Management (PSM) environment
 Knowledge of fabrication and integration processes, systems engineering and quality control practices
 MS in engineering or PMP certification
 


 Culture Statement 
 Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

 Export Control Regulations 
 Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

 Background Check 
 Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
 Required for Certain Job Profiles:  Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
 Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
 Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical
 
 Benefits 
 Benefits include:  Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
 Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
 Paid Time Off:  Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
 Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details. 
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here .

 Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation 
 Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at  EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com . Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.
